## 8. Slice fixtures, replay and vendor peer

### Writer, trigger and transaction contract

The 0022 generalization is mandatory before 0025. For `ev_charging`, `analytic_run.cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`; the complete Finding/Revision NOT NULL mapping and `'mini_grid'` keyed CHECKs in the cold design apply. EV FindingRevision `episode_start=START source_time`, `episode_end=ABORT source_time`; its three dispatch minute columns are null. `support_sha256` hashes sorted exact START/FAULT/ABORT evidence ID+SHA pairs, `cited_evidence_sha256` hashes the exact cited accepted set, and `input_evidence_sha256=analytic_run.input_sha256`. No fault-abort Finding is created before all three accepted facts exist.

Rule 8 `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1`: add `ev_session,ev_session_revision,ev_session_evidence,ev_meter_interval` to `$assessTables` before `$assessInserts` is derived; add `ev_consequence_revision,ev_consequence_session,ev_consequence_evidence` to `$consequenceTables`, then add `ev_consequence_work,ev_consequence_work_attempt` to the same `$consequenceTables` array. `postgres_assessment_store.py` exclusively inserts the four session tables, `postgres_finding_store.py` exclusively inserts Findings, and `postgres_consequence_store.py` exclusively inserts the three EV consequence tables and appends work attempts. Migration triggers alone insert work; the consequence writer appends a `SUCCEEDED` attempt atomically with consequence/links or a `FAILED` attempt with error code. Work and attempts are append-only; runtime work INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE are rejected. Cross-writer checks cover `$consequenceTables`. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied transaction containing analytic run, assessment, session revision/links, FindingRevision/links and job completion. `financials/recompute.py` owns a separate transaction containing consequence/links and successful work-attempt append. No SQL writer enters HTTP/domain modules and no `DO UPDATE` allowlist entry is added. The 0020 message-only conflict target, per-ordinal savepoint/reread precedence and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds permitted owner INSERT and work-attempt append, rejects runtime work INSERT, immutable work/attempt UPDATE or DELETE, foreign owner, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes pass/fail probes for both multi-adapter transaction paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.

`0026` adds append-only `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, created_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`) and `ev_consequence_work_attempt` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, work_id scoped FK, attempt_no int>0, outcome `SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, error_code nullable, started_at, finished_at; UNIQUE `(work_id,attempt_no)`, partial unique successful attempt per work). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` selects unfinished work lacking a successful attempt, takes an advisory transaction lock per work ID, writes a Site window revision and links, and appends a `SUCCEEDED` attempt atomically; failure appends `FAILED` and remains retryable. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

### Response vocabulary

Use the cold design's common `currentness.state`, `source_provenance`, `limitations`, UUID/time/decimal JSON types and exact envelope. EV `start_bounds,end_bounds` are `{earliest:UTC timestamp|null,latest:UTC timestamp|null}`. Session `reason_codes` is an array drawn only from `MISSING_START|MISSING_TERMINAL|CONFLICTING_TERMINAL|CONFLICTING_START|CONNECTOR_MISMATCH|METER_GAP|METER_OVERLAP|METER_INVALID|CLOCK_UNATTESTED|SOURCE_UNVERIFIED|PENDING_RECOMPUTE`. `links` is `{self:string|null,evidence:string|null,analysis:string|null,finding:string|null,financials:string|null}`; null means no supported destination. Foundation `readiness.state=READY_TO_REPORT|CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE`, `commissioning.state=CONFIRMED|UNCONFIRMED`, `contact.state=RECENT|STALE|NEVER`; `messages` uses exactly the codes in Â§2. Capability `state=SUPPORTED|LIMITED|UNAVAILABLE|CONTRADICTORY` and `claim=SESSION_OUTCOME|DELIVERED_ENERGY|FAULT_ASSOCIATION|SERVICE_STATE|SITE_POWER_CONTEXT|POWER_CONSTRAINT|GROSS_TARIFF_SCENARIO`; `required_roles,missing_roles:string[]`, `coverage={known_seconds:int,expected_seconds:int,ratio:decimal}`. `site_power.coverage` has that same shape; `claim_limit` is a string drawn from `CONTEXT_ONLY|REQUEST_AND_LIMIT_OBSERVED|UNKNOWN`.

Canonical manifests in `contract-fixtures/w2/ev/` use `ev-replay-manifest/1`: fixture Site/Foundation/binding/source IDs, UTC window, scenario/profile/model/observation SHAs, seed, expected public envelope/batch SHAs, receipt dispositions, accepted evidence IDs, assessment/consequence basis SHAs and bounded assertions. IDs are fixture constants only. Run twice for byte-identical public replay and duplicate receipts; Stage/Batch/accepted/API bytes exclude private forcing. **Recommendation for the owner: defer `vendor-format-ev-peer/1` to the pilot gate.** W2-05b's registered Lab path and deterministic v4 contract cover the demonstration; an extra parser and cumulative-register fixture cost work without improving the W2 walkthrough. The later pilot contract is OCPP 1.6J JSON `StartTransaction`, `StopTransaction`, `MeterValues`: `timestamp` ISO UTC, `connectorId` integer mapped to registered connector, `transactionId` string scoped session ID, `meterStart/meterStop` Wh integers, `sampledValue.measurand='Energy.Active.Import.Register'`, `unit='Wh'`. `backend/assetops_backend/evidence/adapters/ocpp16j_ev_adapter.py` owns raw-to-v4 conversion; adjacent monotone Wh samples become exact kWh deltas by division by 1000. One `ColdSelection` has `tenant_id,site_id,code,from_at,to_at,known_at,watermark,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,assessment_revision_id,finding_revision_ids,source_gate`. `from_at` and `to_at` are UTC and half-open; `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark captured once at request start. Omitted `from,to` selects W2-03's latest settled cold window; exactly one omitted is 422. The effective Foundation/binding is selected at each evidence source time (W2-03), with the selected policy at the requested window; conflicting/absent effective revision is an explicit limitation. 31 days maximum. No newer assessment, Finding or consequence may be silently mixed with an older `known_at`. A late accepted report makes the current projection `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until a new exact assessment and cold consequence both settle. A selected old cutoff is `HISTORICAL`, even when there is no pending work. Determine probe freshness from the latest qualifying accepted probe `source_time` within `[from,to)` compared with `to`: over 10 minutes is `STALE_SOURCE`. Later wall-clock viewing of the 2026-10-06 replay never alone makes it stale or live. Precedence: overlapping queued/failed newer work -> `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`; explicit cutoff older than latest relevant committed disposition -> `HISTORICAL`; no settled selection/probe or future `to` -> `UNKNOWN`; old last probe -> `STALE_SOURCE`; otherwise `CURRENT`. Money can remain `UNPRICED` within a current technical read; pending/old/unresolved money has its own withholding limit.

`ColdSiteReadService` joins, by exact UUIDs, W2-03 `ColdReadService` output, W2-01 Foundation, S4-05 source/publication links and the cold consequence head. It does not use a display-name join or the latest Finding irrespective of window. Capability claims are exactly `TEMPERATURE_POINT,EXCURSION_BOUNDS,BACKUP_START_RESULT,TRANSFER_POSITION,COOLING_RESPONSE,PRODUCT_EXPOSURE`. Each has `state:SUPPORTED|LIMITED|UNAVAILABLE|CONTRADICTORY`, `required_roles:string[]`, `missing_roles:string[]`, `coverage:{known_points:int,expected_points:int,ratio:decimal string}` and `as_of,limitation`. `TEMPERATURE_POINT` requires GOOD calibrated room probe and attested clock; `EXCURSION_BOUNDS` adds policy, two qualifying samples and >=0.8 coverage with no >10-minute bridge; `BACKUP_START_RESULT` requires correlated accepted request/result and the W2-03 causal rules; `TRANSFER_POSITION` needs its own bound transfer report; `COOLING_RESPONSE` needs an accepted compressor state and probe series; `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` means bounded thermal exposure only and requires an eligible excursion. Contradictory accepted facts give `CONTRADICTORY`, not healthy/failure. Source `contact` derives from a diagnostic received no later than selected `known_at` only when that diagnostic actually identifies the source; if only gateway-level contact exists, source contact is `UNKNOWN` with a limitation. `fact_age` is a nonnegative integer number of seconds/null between selected `to` and the last accepted source fact in `[from,to)` at the cutoff; it is distinct from contact. No source contact becomes equipment condition. Panel 3's â€œnext evidenceâ€ is simply a named missing role/link, never a scored recommendation.

Analysis rows are selected accepted public records from the pinned assessment basis and exact links, ordered `(source_time,evidence_id)`, with `evidence_id,kind,source_time,received_at,quality,role,exclusion,source_id,envelope_sha256,assessment_revision_id`; `exclusion` is W2-03's SUPPORT/CONTEXT/EXCLUDED reason or null. Keep a record in the list when excluded, label why, and link to the existing Site Evidence exact record when source gate permits. `claim_rules` lists rule ID `cold-excursion/1` or `cold-start-response/1`, requirement, observed/missing role, coverage and resulting limit, all derived from the selected assessment; no speculative prose rule. Opaque cursor encodes `(source_time,evidence_id)` and selected basis SHA; mismatch returns 409 rather than changing pages.

## Money schema `0023` and rules

Create four new tables (do not widen the mini-grid `financial_consequence_revision`, whose CHECK constrains `POTENTIAL_FUEL_COST`, `fuel-cost-1`, L and priced amount). The Site FK uses `(tenant_id,site_id)` -> `site(tenant_id,id)`; references to FindingRevision, cold episode revision, assessment revision and accepted evidence use composite `(tenant_id,site_id,id)` keys; the source link uses `(tenant_id,site_id,batch_id)`. Add scoped unique targets to referenced tables only where `0022` has not already supplied them. All tables have `tenant_id,site_id`; every immutable row has server `created_at`/`finished_at`, with UPDATE/DELETE refusal triggers. Downgrade refuses while any of these rows exist; otherwise drops only W2-04 triggers/tables/indexes, including its added scoped unique target on the older link table.

* `cold_consequence_revision`: `id uuid PK`, `finding_revision_id`, `episode_revision_id`, `assessment_revision_id` UUID NOT NULL; `revision_no int >0`, `prior_revision_id uuid NULL`; `kind` CHECK `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE|RECORDED_REPAIR`; `state` CHECK `UNPRICED|WITHHELD`; `reason` nonempty; `window_start,window_end timestamptz` with start<end; `room_asset_id uuid`; `overlap_group text`; `quantity_unit` CHECK `degC_min|none`; `quantity_low,quantity_high numeric NULL` nonnegative/ordered; `amount_low,amount_high numeric NULL`, `currency char(3) NULL`; `finding_basis_sha256,consequence_basis_sha256 char(64)`, `model_id` CHECK `cold-exposure/1|cold-repair/1`; `source_classification`, `source_gate_sha256 char(64)`, `assumption_revision_ids jsonb` array, `limitation text NULL`. Unique `(finding_revision_id,kind,revision_no)`, `(finding_revision_id,kind,consequence_basis_sha256)` and scoped `(tenant_id,site_id,id)` for evidence links. DB CHECK requires `amount_low IS NULL AND amount_high IS NULL AND currency IS NULL` for every row; a later approved migration must widen this. `quantity_unit='none'` requires both quantity bounds null; `degC_min` allows null bounds only when the technical claim is limited/withheld. No `RECORDED_REPAIR` row is created for the six replays because no exact accepted cost/work feed exists. `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` may carry nonnegative bounded `degC_min`; if insufficient evidence both bounds null. No zero amount or stock count stands for unknown.
* `cold_consequence_evidence`: `consequence_revision_id,evidence_id,use,reason` with PK `(consequence_revision_id,evidence_id,use)`, `use=SUPPORT|CONTEXT|EXCLUDED` and scoped FKs. Include all exact evidence cited by the pinned Finding/episode basis, no private world keys.
* `cold_consequence_work`: `id uuid PK`, `cause` CHECK `FINDING_REVISION_APPENDED|EPISODE_REVISION_APPENDED|SOURCE_GATE_CHANGED`; nullable `finding_revision_id`, `episode_revision_id`, `publication_batch_id`, with a CHECK requiring exactly the locator for its cause, and scoped FKs; `window_start,window_end` (nonempty, half-open), `room_asset_id`, `dirty_key_sha256 char(64)`, `enqueued_at`; unique `(tenant_id,site_id,dirty_key_sha256)` and `(tenant_id,site_id,id)` for attempts. Add `(tenant_id,site_id,batch_id)` uniqueness to `batch_publication_link` in 0023 for the scoped `publication_batch_id` FK; `batch_id` is that table's actual PK, there is no link `id`. Trigger-only INSERT with `ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,site_id,dirty_key_sha256) DO NOTHING`. A cold FindingRevision or episode revision enqueues its selected Site/window/room; the source-gate trigger enqueues only overlapping heads. No runtime work insert/status update. Backfill existing W2-03 cold heads once during upgrade, idempotently. `0010_financial_assumptions` has a diesel-only DB CHECK as well as a diesel-only publisher: **no `ASSUMPTION_PUBLISHED` cause or trigger in 0023**. A future cold assumption contract must migrate the DB, publisher and dirty-work cause together.
* `cold_consequence_work_attempt`: `id uuid PK`, `work_id` scoped FK, `attempt_no int >0`, `outcome` CHECK `SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, `error_code text NULL`, `consequence_revision_ids jsonb` array, `finished_at`; unique `(work_id,attempt_no)`. Success has no error and exact returned IDs; failure has error and empty IDs. A failed attempt leaves work pending; pending means no successful attempt. Index `(site_id,enqueued_at)` and `(work_id,attempt_no DESC)`.

`overlap_group = 'cold:' + sha256(canonical JSON array [tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,room_asset_id])`: literal lowercase `cold:` prefix, then 64 lowercase hex characters; it is a grouping label, not a V4 event/correlation ID (whose grammar excludes `:`). An excursion and backup Finding of the same selected room/window share it; the financial read groups `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` by this key and takes the single selected excursion exposure basis, never sums both. The start-response Finding may carry a `WITHHELD` context consequence with the same key but zero *counted* exposure entries, not a numeric zero. No cross-window summing without an explicit disjoint-window contract.

The source-gate event is an appended `batch_publication_link` to a previously accepted cold batch, if one exists; its trigger selects only cold heads whose linked accepted IDs use that batch and enqueues `SOURCE_GATE_CHANGED` inside the link transaction. An initial link before acceptance has no heads and creates no money work; later W2-03 Finding/episode append enqueues it. `evidence_publication` is immutable and a new unrelated publication never dirties an existing cold basis. Each trigger derives the same canonical dirty key from `(cause,locator,tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,room_asset_id)` and takes a Site advisory transaction lock before selecting heads, following `0012_evidence_consequence_work.py`'s enqueue lock pattern. The FindingRevision trigger is restricted to `NEW.domain='cold_chain'`. An episode with no warranted Finding still enqueues; the worker records a successful no-op attempt with an empty consequence ID array. No trigger on an accepted disposition bypasses W2-03 assessment: it waits for the new exact cold Finding/episode revision.

`cold-exposure/1` derives observed rectangle degree-minute bounds only from W2-03's persisted episode bounds/accepted evidence, not a continuous curve. A bounded positive or zero technical quantity is allowed only when W2-03 actually proved it; missing-probe/contradictory has null quantity. `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` is unpriced for sound technical bounds because no `cold_stock_quantity`, `cold_stock_unit_value`, reviewed `cold_exposure_rule`, product/currency binding or source-gated valuation exists. These are **reserved future scenario keys**, displayed as missing, not publishable via the diesel-price publisher. Product value/currency and EV tariff would be explicitly authored scenario assumptions and still would not prove sales, collections, spoilage or lost revenue. Recorded repair needs an accepted exact cost/currency/work record; none of the six replay cases has one. Mixed/unknown source, closed S4-05 gate, stale/pending assessment, incomplete period or contradictory evidence yields `WITHHELD` and null amount. LR current-money gate also refuses a current money claim from historical/pending basis. `exact_basis` returns selected Finding/episode/assessment UUIDs, accepted evidence UUIDs, source gate digest, assumption revision UUIDs (empty in W2) and consequence basis SHA. Basis SHA hashes canonical sorted IDs, window/cutoff, model/formula version, quantity bounds, source gate and missing assumption markers; an identical basis returns the existing ID and a changed basis appends a new revision.

`PostgresConsequenceStore` alone inserts `cold_consequence_revision`, `cold_consequence_evidence` and `cold_consequence_work_attempt`; add separate cold methods without changing the existing mini-grid methods. `cold_recompute.process_one` selects unfinished work under `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('cold_consequence:' || work_id,0))`, takes one repeatable-read snapshot, refuses a foreign/missing exact basis, writes consequence/links and `SUCCEEDED` attempt in one transaction. On derivation failure it rolls back that transaction and appends a typed `FAILED` attempt in a fresh transaction. A crash before success commits leaves no partial revision; retries are idempotent. `run` uses the existing `financials/recompute.py:retry_due_at` 1,2,4,8,16-minute schedule and bounded batch; one bad work item cannot starve others. Trigger-created work does not depend on a successful worker.

## Five API reads

`cold_site_api.py:build_cold_site_router` mounts five GET paths below `/api/sites/{site_code}/cold`. Request query for all is optional paired `from,to`, optional `known_at` (strict UTC); Analysis additionally `cursor,limit` (default 50, max 200), matching W2-03's paging spelling. Use W2-03 shared common envelope exactly: `site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness:{state,watermark,latest_relevant_evidence_at,pending_since},source_provenance:{classification,source_ids,evidence_ids,basis_sha256},limitations`. Every card/object includes `as_of` and `limitation`; scalar decimals serialize as decimal strings and absent values as JSON null. `currentness.state` is `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`. Valid empty selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN` and empty arrays. Use one selected repeatable-read snapshot for W2-03, source disclosure and consequence heads. No previous consequence becomes a current money claim while a relevant cold work item is queued or failed. Errors use `{error:{code,message}}`; never downgrade 503 into a blank page.

Refusal code contract (same scope and parse semantics as `cold_assessment_api.py:build_cold_assessment_router`): 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`; 403 `SITE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN` or `COLD_SOURCE_DISCLOSURE_FORBIDDEN`; 404 `SITE_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `COLD_SELECTION_UNSETTLED` for an explicitly requested revision that has no settled exact basis or `COLD_CURSOR_BASIS_CHANGED` for a changed Analysis basis; 422 `COLD_TIME_INVALID`, `COLD_WINDOW_INVALID`, `COLD_WINDOW_TOO_LONG`, `COLD_PARAMETER_UNKNOWN`, `COLD_LIMIT_INVALID`, or `COLD_CURSOR_INVALID`; 503 `COLD_READ_UNAVAILABLE`. A wrong-type/foreign Site is 404 after access is checked. An absent optional current basis is 200 `UNKNOWN`, not a 409. Analysis cursor is unpadded base64url of sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON `{basis:<64 lowercase hex>,id:<UUID string>,t:<UTC instant>}`; malformed is 422 and an exact basis mismatch is 409. No arbitrary `after` offset or page across a changed basis.

| GET suffix | Exact additional response |
| --- | --- |
| `/overview` | `status:{state:OBSERVED_EXCURSION|NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY,claim_level,as_of,limitation}`, `objective:{text,policy_low_deg_c,policy_high_deg_c,room_asset_id,as_of,limitation}`, `temperature_summary:{latest_deg_c,latest_at,coverage:{known_points,expected_points,ratio},episode_count,claim_level,as_of,limitation}`, `backup_summary:{attempts,observed_success,observed_failure,unknown,latest_chain_id,as_of,limitation}`, `causal_strip:[{step:GRID|START_REQUEST|START_RESULT|GENERATOR|TRANSFER|BUS|COMPRESSOR|PROBE,state:OBSERVED|MISSING|CONTRADICTORY,at,evidence_id,as_of,limitation}]`, `findings:{count,items:[{finding_id,revision_id,title,claim_level,link}],as_of,limitation}`, `needs_attention:[{code,text,link,as_of,limitation}]`, `consequence_summary:{state:UNPRICED|WITHHELD|UNKNOWN,quantity:{low,high,unit:'degC_min'|null},amount:{low:null,high:null,currency:null},overlap_group,as_of,limitation}`, `links:{temperature,backup,findings,evidence,analysis,financials}`. The response includes W2-03 selected temperature points only through its linked read, never repackages model truth. |
| `/evidence` | `capabilities:[{claim,state,required_roles,missing_roles,coverage,as_of,limitation}]`, `sources:[{id,role,contact,fact_age,accepted_count,last_accepted_at,as_of,limitation}]`, `links:{analysis,foundation,temperature,backup}`. `contact` is `RECENT|STALE|NEVER|UNKNOWN`; `fact_age` is duration/null, never equipment condition. |

Return one counted exposure per overlap group; the optional backup context row is marked nonadditive. |
| `/financial-assumptions` | `items:[{key,revision_id,value,unit,currency,valid_from,valid_to,recorded_at,source,as_of,limitation}]`, `missing_keys:['cold_stock_quantity','cold_stock_unit_value','cold_exposure_rule']` in this slice, `publication_state:'NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_W2'`, `links:{financials}`. `items=[]` for six canonical replays. This is a read-only explicit absence statement, not a publication form. |

Links carry the exact selected `from,to,known_at` and record/revision ID through route builders, URL encoded. The Site overview's Finding count counts distinct current Finding IDs, not episode revisions. `needs_attention` is ordered: pending recompute, probe gap, observed start failure, unknown transfer, missing policy; omit a code only when its predicate is false. No â€œnext actionâ€ link unless an actual W2-03 Finding or Evidence destination exists.

## Final Architect rulings on commit 1 (Q1-Q10)

This section overrides shorthand above where the two differ. Migration `0023` on `task/W2-04-cold-site-evidence-money` is provisional until its listed corrections are made; passing migration tests do not waive them.

1. **Q1 CHANGE â€” selected window and room.** Keep `assessment_revision.window_start/window_end` for each trigger; neither episode bounds nor `window_assessment_revision_id` is a money window. For an `EXCURSION`, `cold_episode.asset_id` is the room. For a `START_RESPONSE`, that asset and the start Finding's `subject_asset_id` are the **generator**, so they must never fill `room_asset_id` or the overlap key. Resolve the effective chamber room from the exact assessment's selected `cold-roles-1` Foundation/binding basis (the same room that its temperature policy names); require one scoped room, or raise and roll back. Apply this to the Finding trigger, episode trigger, source-gate trigger and backfill. Prove that excursion and start Finding for one assessment produce the same room/window/group and that no generator ID is stored as a room.
2. **Q2 ACCEPT.** Source-gate link dirties latest cold episode heads citing the batch through `cold_episode_evidence` and latest cold Finding heads citing it through `finding_revision_evidence`. Scope every subquery by tenant and Site as well as parent ID; distinct heads may produce distinct work rows but identical selected consequence basis returns the same revision.
3. **Q3 CHANGE â€” preserve instant precision.** Canonical JSON array of strings and lowercase hyphenated UUIDs stand. Use UTC `Z` timestamps with six fractional digits **when microseconds are nonzero**, and whole seconds otherwise. This selected-window key is distinct from `source_envelope.instant_text`, which emits whole seconds for envelope publication; W2-03's `_instant` accepts fractional selected bounds. Reject precision beyond microseconds at the API boundary; never truncate a selected window to seconds when hashing. The six replay windows happen to have whole seconds. SQL and Python golden vectors must match for whole-second and fractional inputs.
4. **Q4 ACCEPT with meaning.** `limitation IS NOT NULL` means a named technical limit, not an arbitrary note. For an open W2-03 excursion with lower `degC_min` and null upper, keep `UNPRICED`, store that partial bound and a nonempty `OPEN_EPISODE_UPPER_UNKNOWN` limitation. `WITHHELD` may have either/both null bounds. A sound closed exposure has both. Null amount/currency remains mandatory in every case.
5. **Q5 ACCEPT each extra.** Keep scoped self-FK, first-revision/prior-link CHECK, kind/model pairing, nonnull scoped room FK on revision and work, and nullable evidence-link reason. Add a same-Finding/kind predecessor check in store logic; FK alone does not prove chain membership. A successful no-Finding episode gets a no-op attempt, not a fabricated Finding or consequence.
6. **Q6 ACCEPT.** The listed `DEFAULT clock_timestamp()` columns, including evidence-link `created_at`, are server times. The sole store writer must omit them, and tests must assert they lie in the DB transaction's observed interval. Do not accept client timestamps in store methods. A forcing trigger is unnecessary for this owner-restricted append-only table.
7. **Q7 CHANGE â€” constrain the aggregate.** `source_classification` is exactly `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|MIXED|UNKNOWN`, the values returned by `evidence/source_provenance.py`; add a SQL CHECK. `ATTESTED_REAL_SOURCE` is not a current class. Preserve reason/detail and exact IDs separately; `UNKNOWN` and `MIXED` withhold money.
8. **Q8 ACCEPT.** Missing room or invalid assessment window is an invariant violation: raise and roll back the W2-03 assessment/Finding transaction, following `0012` rather than silently dropping dirty work. The worker reports `FAILED` for later derivation faults; it cannot repair a missing enqueue.
9. **Q9 ACCEPT with a nonvacuous guard.** Rule 8 scans runtime modules, so inspect the exact `0023` migration separately. Require at least one `INSERT INTO cold_consequence_work`, and require every such INSERT to use `ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, site_id, dirty_key_sha256) DO NOTHING`; reject `DO UPDATE`, another arbiter or a missing INSERT. Probe by mutating a temporary copy of the migration and restoring it, with pass and fail cases; no probe may pass solely because migrations are skipped by the runtime scan.
10. **Q10 ACCEPT staged enforcement.** Commit 1 installs table/owner/probe-name registration and refuses foreign and mutating writes. Commit 2 adds real store INSERTs and enables per-table `inserts seen` assertions for revision, evidence and attempt. Before commit 2 is declared done, all three must be nonvacuously seen; no empty/fake SQL is allowed to satisfy the guard. The trigger-only work check is active in commit 1.

## Implementer dry-read: exact backend behavior

| Question a builder would otherwise decide | Binding answer and proof |
| --- | --- |
| Which Finding gets an exposure revision? | Only a selected, warranted `EXCURSION` FindingRevision with an exact `claim.episode_revision_id` and eligible episode. `START_RESPONSE` is chronology/context; do not emit the optional context consequence in W2-04. A successful start, unsupported excursion, or missing-probe episode without a Finding produces no consequence and may close its trigger work with an empty-ID success attempt. This avoids a second counted exposure and an invented zero row. |
| Which assessment is exact? | Join FindingRevision `assessment_revision_id`, `claim.episode_revision_id`, episode revision `assessment_revision_id`, and the selected W2-03 assessment pair by scoped IDs. A mismatch is a typed worker failure `COLD_BASIS_MISMATCH`, never a latest-row fallback. For a source-gate event, re-read the latest settled heads at its transaction snapshot and enqueue only heads whose exact evidence IDs use the linked batch. |
| How is `degC_min` computed? | Copy the selected excursion revision's `degree_minutes_low/high` as decimal strings after checking policy, coverage and evidence eligibility. Do not integrate an interpolated chart, derive from duration alone or use private trajectory. Preserve a proved lower bound with unknown upper as in Q4. `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED` has no exposure row; no episode means `UNKNOWN` summary if the selection is otherwise incomplete. |
| How does revision identity work? | Hash the sorted exact accepted IDs with their SUPPORT/CONTEXT/EXCLUDED uses and reasons, Finding/episode/assessment UUIDs and basis hashes, selected window/cutoff, `cold-exposure/1`, quantity bounds, aggregate source class/gate digest, and explicit missing cold assumption markers. Existing identical `(finding_revision_id,kind,basis_sha256)` returns its ID. A changed basis appends `revision_no=max+1` and `prior_revision_id` under the work advisory lock. Never overwrite; reversion to a previously used basis must remain audit-visible, so include the newly selected cutoff/revision ID in the hash. |
| What exactly is pending and when does a work item finish? | Unfinished means no `SUCCEEDED` attempt. Include any relevant PENDING/LEASED/FAILED W2-03 cold assessment job and any cold consequence work with no success; a failed attempt does not clear pending. Relevant means same tenant/Site, overlapping half-open selected window and room. Select work in `(enqueued_at,id)` order, lock its UUID, and use `retry_due_at` from the last attempt; no row status UPDATE. An episode-only no-op success has `[]` IDs. |
| Which source/cutoff gates apply? | Resolve S4-05 aggregate provenance from the exact evidence IDs, not Site mode or a Lab manifest. Recompute after a new publication link. Return historical technical rows at an older explicit `known_at` with the historical label; never call their amount current. Closed disclosure gives 403 before returning restricted accepted IDs; mixed/unknown classification and pending/stale currentness withhold a current money claim. No cold price exists even with coherent simulation. |
| What does `RECORDED_REPAIR` mean here? | It is schema reserved only. Neither a W2-03 start Finding nor mock WR-019 is an accepted, costed work record. No `RECORDED_REPAIR` row, repair amount, currency, incident or maintenance item is synthesized in W2-04. |
| How does the API keep one snapshot? | Authenticate and scope Site first. Open one repeatable-read transaction; capture latest committed S2 disposition watermark once, resolve paired window and optional `known_at`, then call W2-03 read/store, Foundation, source provenance and consequence read methods with the same connection. If W2-03 exposes only HTTP calls, add a caller-connection read method to its existing assessment adapter; never invoke loopback HTTP for composition or import a SQL driver into `cold_site_reads.py`. |
| What is a valid explicit selection/cursor? | `from,to,known_at` are strict UTC instants; both window bounds or neither, `from<to`, at most 31 days, no unknown query keys. `known_at` cannot exceed the captured committed watermark for claims; a future cutoff is 422 `COLD_TIME_INVALID`. Cursor stores exact canonical selection/basis and `(source_time,evidence_id)`; a well-formed cursor for another selection or changed basis is 409. Page after the tuple, never by offset. Empty selected evidence is 200 `UNKNOWN`; unavailable/corrupt storage is 503, not empty. |
| What do `as_of` and contact mean? | For an accepted record, `as_of=received_at` (with separate `source_time`); for assessment/episode/Finding, use immutable revision `created_at`; for consequence use its `created_at`; for a configured policy use effective revision time; for a missing value use selected `known_at` and a limitation. Source contact uses only an identified source-specific diagnostic at/before cutoff; otherwise `UNKNOWN`, even if a gateway is online. Accepted fact age is `to - latest qualifying source_time`, separate from contact. |
| Where do exact links go? | Only emit a clickable target after an integration test proves the target route renders that exact ID with Site, window and cutoff preserved. For an unproved cold record or assessment target, display the exact ID as labelled text plus `Analysis view not available for this cold record`; Finding and Site Evidence links that pass their own route proof remain clickable. Never turn a mock Action, Incident, Maintenance or unbuilt Cooling destination into a link. |

Use `cold_site_reads.py` as a pure composition service, and put SQL in the existing assessment/consequence adapters. `financials/cold_recompute.py` receives store protocols and no SQL driver. The five GETs are composed in `main.py`; do not change the mini-grid routers. Run architecture/dependency, workflow, writer guard and targeted import probes after each owning commit. The review packet states the exact migration SHA, W2-03 predecessor revision, replay manifest IDs, accepted IDs, selected revision IDs and test database name.

## 4. W2-06 session correlation, meter sum, Finding, currentness

Select only accepted, GOOD, clock-attested records with valid effective Foundation/binding and exact `(tenant,site,charger,connector,session_id)`; EVENT session ID comes from W2-00, energy identity from the v4 measurement extension above. Require one START, at most one terminal END or ABORT, ordered by source time with <=30-second declared cross-source clock error; a terminal without START remains orphan context, not a session. An END is COMPLETED only when same scoped ID, no competing ABORT, and no contradictory state; explicit ABORT proves OBSERVED_ABORT, while contemporaneous fault on the same connector/session is additionally required for a **fault-associated** Finding. Fault alone does not prove an abort. Missing terminal is INCOMPLETE regardless of apparently idle status; conflicting good terminal/start times or incompatible connector identity is CONTRADICTORY. `SUSPECT` and unbound reports are context/excluded with reasons, never settle outcomes. Repeat events are deduped by W2-00 and cross-tenant/session collisions cannot join.

For each session, intersect GOOD connector `INTERVAL_DELTA` reports with `[start,terminal)` and same session ID; accept only wholly contained, nonoverlapping half-open intervals with finite `0<=kWh<=connector_max_kW*duration_hours+2*meter_error_bound`, and matching exact source. Do **not** pro-rate a report spanning a boundary, choose between conflicting duplicates, substitute power integration or infer zero for an absent slot. `supported_kwh=sum(exact accepted deltas)`; `unknown_meter_seconds` is the union duration of uncovered active 5-minute slots, clipped to session bounds. A delivered-energy total is **complete** only if every active slot is covered (partial boundary slots must have a split report) and no contradiction; otherwise report known partial sum with `energy_complete=false` and unknown time, never call it total delivered. If no supported intervals, quantity null rather than zero. Session outcome counts use START denominator, separately completed/observed abort/incomplete/contradictory; orphan records are separate. No availability percentage or site constraint cause in W2. Synchronized site import below limit is context only; a power-constraint claim requires independent accepted requested and allocated-limit signals plus site import over the same slots, and W2 still labels competing causes unknown (`.agent/architect-W2-design.md:37-49`).

`ev-session/1` assessment basis SHA sorts accepted evidence IDs+content digests, excluded/context IDs+reasons, effective Foundation/binding/mapping IDs, model/rule versions, `[from,to)`, `known_at` and source classification. Session revision and its evidence/interval links append atomically with `assessment_revision` and any FindingRevision. A fault-abort Finding uses the stable key above, with exact fault/abort/START evidence and limitation â€œfault observed; component cause and unmet demand unknown.â€ A completed late END supersedes prior INCOMPLETE by new revision; a contradictory terminal withdraws previous current conclusion. Worker enqueue on **every** newly accepted relevant EV report, including late source time; until latest applicable job settles, previous projection reads `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`, with historical exact revision separately selectable. For current status, latest needed connector state <=2 minutes old at read time and terminal/event sources within declared cadence; old closed sessions may remain historical conclusions. Current service-window coverage uses one-minute status slots and explicit `known_seconds/unknown_seconds`; no available-time inference over gaps >2 minutes. Source gate follows S4-05 exact revision provenance; generated and authored evidence are labelled and mixed/unknown blocks a current positive (`.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15,4165-4188`).

## 5. W2-07 tariff scenario and claim gate

`ev_gross_tariff_per_kwh` is a Site time-valid, recorded revision in `currency/kWh`, with authored basis/source; no default and no billing/collection identity. A window may price only supported energy in completed or observed-abort sessions, each with complete meter coverage and settled current assessment; no session interval is counted twice. For every included meter interval, select exactly one tariff revision whose **valid** range covers it and whose **recorded** range is visible at `known_at`; W2 v1 requires the same revision and currency across the entire priced window, otherwise `UNPRICED/PRICE_GAP_OR_CHANGE` (no averaging). Formula `amount = Î£ exact interval kWh Ã— tariff value`, unrounded in storage; display rounding only. `quantity_kwh` and exact session revision/accepted meter evidence/tariff revision IDs are pinned. No lost-sales estimate: private requested power, incomplete sessions and fault downtime do not measure counterfactual demand. An aborted session can contribute **delivered** pre-abort energy, never lost energy. W1 LR current-money gate and S4-05 coherent source gate apply: pending/late/revised assessment, conflicting meter, historical cutoff, mixed/unknown provenance, unsupported tariff, or missing price â†’ `WITHHELD` or `UNPRICED`, null amount (not zero). Historical amount may appear labelled historical only under its exact old basis, never as today's current money. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))` prevents adding the same meter intervals through multiple Findings; Site scenario is one window revision, not per-Finding additive totals (`backend/migrations/versions/0010_financial_assumptions.py:38-102`; `.ai/DECISIONS.md:5-15`).

### Writer, trigger and transaction contract

The 0022 generalization is mandatory before 0025. For `ev_charging`, `analytic_run.cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`; the complete Finding/Revision NOT NULL mapping and `'mini_grid'` keyed CHECKs in the cold design apply. EV FindingRevision `episode_start=START source_time`, `episode_end=ABORT source_time`; its three dispatch minute columns are null. `support_sha256` hashes sorted exact START/FAULT/ABORT evidence ID+SHA pairs, `cited_evidence_sha256` hashes the exact cited accepted set, and `input_evidence_sha256=analytic_run.input_sha256`. No fault-abort Finding is created before all three accepted facts exist.

Rule 8 `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1`: add `ev_session,ev_session_revision,ev_session_evidence,ev_meter_interval` to `$assessTables` before `$assessInserts` is derived; add `ev_consequence_revision,ev_consequence_session,ev_consequence_evidence` to `$consequenceTables`, then add `ev_consequence_work,ev_consequence_work_attempt` to the same `$consequenceTables` array. `postgres_assessment_store.py` exclusively inserts the four session tables, `postgres_finding_store.py` exclusively inserts Findings, and `postgres_consequence_store.py` exclusively inserts the three EV consequence tables and appends work attempts. Migration triggers alone insert work; the consequence writer appends a `SUCCEEDED` attempt atomically with consequence/links or a `FAILED` attempt with error code. Work and attempts are append-only; runtime work INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE are rejected. Cross-writer checks cover `$consequenceTables`. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied transaction containing analytic run, assessment, session revision/links, FindingRevision/links and job completion. `financials/recompute.py` owns a separate transaction containing consequence/links and successful work-attempt append. No SQL writer enters HTTP/domain modules and no `DO UPDATE` allowlist entry is added. The 0020 message-only conflict target, per-ordinal savepoint/reread precedence and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds permitted owner INSERT and work-attempt append, rejects runtime work INSERT, immutable work/attempt UPDATE or DELETE, foreign owner, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes pass/fail probes for both multi-adapter transaction paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.

`0026` adds append-only `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, created_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`) and `ev_consequence_work_attempt` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, work_id scoped FK, attempt_no int>0, outcome `SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, error_code nullable, started_at, finished_at; UNIQUE `(work_id,attempt_no)`, partial unique successful attempt per work). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` selects unfinished work lacking a successful attempt, takes an advisory transaction lock per work ID, writes a Site window revision and links, and appends a `SUCCEEDED` attempt atomically; failure appends `FAILED` and remains retryable. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

**QA-QD amendment (2026-10-18; governs the W2-05a commit-1 handoff).**

- **QA, timezone:** Use `Etc/UTC` as the EV-LAB-001 Site timezone and as both schedule `time_zone` values, with `utc_offset_minutes=0`. It is an IANA Area/Location name accepted by the shared Site parser. Do not widen that parser for bare `UTC`; replace the earlier fixture wording `UTC` wherever it denotes a Site or schedule zone. UTC timestamps and offset-zero semantics are unchanged.
- **QB, property kinds:** `ev-charger-max-power`, `ev-connector-max-power`, `ev-meter-resolution`, `ev-meter-error-bound` and `ev-clock-error-bound` are `PHYSICAL`. `ev-site-import-limit`, `ev-status-cadence` and `ev-meter-cadence` are `CONTROL`. `ev-connector-enabled` remains `CONTROL`. These are definition kinds, independent of whether a value is currently observed.
- **QC, absent feed:** A Site with no `AC_BUS` may publish a declared charger, meter and connector as an incomplete configuration, provided all declared charger/connector properties and schedule entries are valid. More than one parent for a meter, charger or connector always refuses publication. Once a feed is declared, every declared meter must have exactly that feed as its parent and every declared charger must have exactly one path through a meter from that feed; an unfed meter or charger refuses `EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID`. Any nonempty connector service schedule requires a complete feedâ†’meterâ†’chargerâ†’connector path, even when the Site has no feed.
- **QD, feed cardinality:** Refuse a second `AC_BUS` in an EV Foundation with `EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID` and a path to the extra feed. The selected response has one `feed`, and no arbitrary feed selection or merged limit is valid. Zero or one feed is publishable subject to the rules above; Draft still requires the feed and its limit.

Build in reviewable commits: **1 vocabulary, parser, typed schedule and validator; 2 EV roles, closed v4 channel matrix, binding publication/snapshot and fixture; 3 selected API; 4 three UI routes and visual proof; 5 migration and final guards/tests.** Commit 5 may be prepared only after W2-04 `0023` is merged into this branch. No interim EV migration is permitted; `0024_w2_ev_config` is reserved for 05a. Run each commit's focused checks and hand off before the next builder run.

**Q1, connector identity.** `BINDING_CHANNEL_OVERLAP` and `EV_CONNECTOR_MISMATCH` stay unchanged. In EV-LAB-001 the c1 tuples are `(c1-charger-controller,session-event)`, `(c1-connector-controller,fault-event|state|requested-power|allocated-limit)`, `(c1-connector-meter,energy|power)`; c2 uses the identical signal names with `c2-` device prefixes. Each of these three devices and seven channels per connector has `component_id=c1` or `c2` respectively and binds to that same EV_CONNECTOR asset. `(site-meter,import)` has `component_id=site-meter-1`, binds to its METER asset, and is the sole Site import channel. `charger-1` is topology and ratings only; it owns no connector channel. Each tuple is a distinct exact entry in `V4_CHANNEL_MAPPINGS`; no prefix wildcard or runtime-generated accepted tuple. **Q2, readiness.** `CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE` applies to `CONNECTOR_NOT_DECLARED`, `FEED_OR_LIMIT_MISSING`, `METER_NOT_BOUND`, `SESSION_EVENTS_NOT_BOUND`, or `STATUS_NOT_BOUND`; `SITE_IMPORT_NOT_BOUND` is a nonblocking capability message under `READY_TO_REPORT`, as are `SOURCE_NOT_CONTACTED` and `COMMISSIONING_UNCONFIRMED`. Missing optional fault, connector power, requested power or allocated limit yields no readiness code; the exact capability that needs it stays unavailable. Required energy, event and state bindings are per declared connector. A configured Site may be ready while source contact and commissioning remain unknown.

**Q3, absent properties.** Missing `ev-site-import-limit` on an otherwise valid feed is the sole publishable numeric gap and emits `FEED_OR_LIMIT_MISSING`; absence of feed or all connectors is likewise publishable as configuration-incomplete so the selected read can explain it. For every *declared* charger/connector, missing `ev-charger-max-power`, `ev-connector-max-power`, `ev-connector-enabled`, `ev-meter-resolution`, `ev-meter-error-bound`, `ev-status-cadence`, `ev-meter-cadence` or `ev-clock-error-bound` refuses Foundation publication with `EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID` and a path to that property. Present wrong type/unit, nonfinite/out-of-range value, invalid topology or schedule uses the same typed refusal. Do not pretend a missing physical or clock parameter is a readiness finding. A Site with no declared connector cannot publish a binding set or Draft a Lab run.

**Q4, cadence.** `ev-status-cadence` on each connector converts min to seconds and must be `0 < value <= 1`; it is the published state-channel cadence. `ev-meter-cadence` converts min to seconds and must be `0 < value <= 5`; it governs connector energy, connector power, Site import, requested power and allocated limit, all of which publish aligned 300-second *maximum* slots for this profile; the fixture declares exactly 5 min. Event channels have null cadence. `BindingRequest` has no cadence field: derive `bindings[].cadence_seconds` only from the selected Foundation property. Reject a property above its ceiling at Foundation publication (`EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID`); reject any future submitted cadence field as `BINDING_REQUEST_INVALID`, not an invented `BINDING_CADENCE_INVALID`. `ev-clock-error-bound` is positive seconds and is recorded as the selected configured tolerance; 05a makes no observed clock-attestation claim. No cadence is inferred from observed timestamps.

**Q5, schedule.** Add `connector_enable_schedules` to `foundation_parsing.py:FOUNDATION_CONTENT_KEYS` and both parser allowlists through that shared constant; it is not `site_controls`. Exactly one schedule entry per declared connector, including a disabled connector (which has an empty `weekly` array); an enabled connector may have an empty weekly array, meaning no service hours. Each entry's zone equals the Site's IANA `timezone`. The fixture zone is `Etc/UTC`, weekly TUESDAY 08:00â€“16:00 with offset 0 for both c1/c2, so it recurs on Tuesdays during the revision's effective period, not just 6 October. For a bounded effective interval, enumerate each occurrence and validate offset and real, unambiguous local endpoints throughout that interval. For an open-ended interval, permit only zones whose offset is fixed for all future occurrences (`Etc/UTC` qualifies); a DST zone needs a bounded revision and a successor when its offset changes. Reject overlap, invalid endpoint and missing entry as `EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID`. At selected `at`, the effective revision supplies its own schedule; never merge schedules across revisions.

Do not emit an unsuffixed `charger-controller/session-event`; those retained W2-00 table entries serve compatibility tests only. The `charger-1` component supplies the common 60 kW rating and parent relation, while c1/c2 each have their own 60 kW limit and meter. `source_id` comes from registration; never synthesize it from device ID. In `gateway/mappings.py` register the EV profile as a distinct closed mapping that uses precisely these tuples and the published 05a binding revision. Report `connector_id` is the bound c1/c2 asset ID, while `session_id` is the deterministic per-run scoped session token, never the charger/component ID. Snapshot role, channel, unit and metadata must agree before Draft; wrong source/asset/tuple/profile yields a typed binding refusal, not a default to cold.

**Fixture timing and profile questions.** 05a authors/imports the fixture and publishes its first EV binding revision. 05b selects the existing complete Foundation/binding revisions effective for the 6 October window; the earlier 1 October import/publish timestamps describe that basis and must not be replayed as new revisions. The scenario document stores UTC window, seed 20517 and exact versioned `ev-charger/1`, `ev-publication/1`, `ev-observation/1`; the one-minute step is fixed by `ev-scenario/1` and is not an extra document key. These are the only selectable values: Lab shows them read-only, rejects a request that differs, and never accepts free-form private forcing. Canonical scenario SHA hashes its strict parsed JSON object with sorted keys, decimal strings and UTC `Z` timestamps; observation SHA hashes the ordered parsed observation rows as specified below. Frozen identity adds those SHAs only for EV; old run fingerprints and artifact serialization remain byte-for-byte the same.

**Scenario and output questions.** The six exact force/observation case tables in `.agent/W2-technical-design-ev.md` Â§3 are normative, including event order and expected numerics; no implementer-chosen seventh event or alternate charging curve. A per-minute private document uses UTC boundary, both connector states/session IDs/requested and allocated kW, site available/import kW, cumulative exact kWh, active fault and forcing ordinal. Sort c1 before c2 at equal boundary, then the design's PLUG-before-FAULT tie rule. Build a deterministic private digest from those 61 boundary documents; only the digest and terminal projection enter the persisted run record. Public state reports are transition plus each minute, with identical same-boundary state deduplicated; power/energy means and deltas cover aligned half-open intervals with split subintervals at session boundaries. Every emitted channel is one of 05a's tuples. Stage admission happens before terminal artifact/schedule is committed; a refused Stage is FAILED, cannot Commit, and retains its refusal code.

**Late, cutoff and replay questions.** `source_time` is the observed transition or interval end; normal `published_at=source_time+3s`. The held late END retains its source time, event ID, report key and payload while release is 09:05 UTC. No first-cutoff success is fabricated from the future report. The selected replay read is exact published evidence for the named run at the request's database snapshot, not a live diagnostic; `receipts` distinguish duplicate, rejected and accepted ordinals. `public_digest` hashes the canonical disposition tuples already specified, in persisted batch order then ordinal order, with a literal null accepted ID when absent. The empty replay hashes canonical `[]`. A second clean replay may use new database UUIDs: compare canonical public report bytes, envelope/batch SHA and disposition shape, while manifest fixture UUID/accepted IDs are pinned for the first controlled fixture database. Do not claim UUID equality across independent databases.

**Lab UI questions.** Follow `frontend/src/shell/ColdRunSetupFrame.tsx`, `coldScenarioChoiceClient.ts` and `simulatorLabRoutes.tsx`: route through the existing Lab Site-first setup, add EV choice only when the selected Site is EV_CHARGING, and keep legacy catalog free of EV entries. Preserve the Lab's existing Site selector, scenario-choice rows, read-only window/seed/profile fields, Draft/Stage/Commit controls, status chips, empty-state area and error/retry placement. The six choices come only from `GET /api/simulator-lab/ev-scenarios?site_id=...`; a 403 is a scoped refusal in the same panel, 404 is unknown Site, an empty list says `No EV test runs are available for this Site`, and 503 says `EV test runs are temporarily unavailable` with retry. The Site financial `ev-scenarios` mock route is a separate unavailable Financials surface and is not populated by this Lab catalog. No Site EV panel is added in 05b.

**Seam/guard questions.** Extend only the closed profile registries and named host execution branches; `host/lab_app.py` injects an EV input port whose implementation re-reads selected Foundation and scenario by exact ID/SHA. The pure pack/public transform imports no SQL, HTTP or accepted-evidence module. Gateway remains the v4 sequence/message/outbox writer, `postgres_evidence_ledger.py` remains accepted/disposition writer, and EV replay uses SELECTs only. `FROZEN_RUN_NOT_RECONSTRUCTIBLE` applies to missing/changed frozen inputs before Stage; unknown schema/profile/document keys refuse before Draft; damaged persisted artifact is `ARTIFACT_UNREADABLE`; Stage publication refusal is `PUBLICATION_REFUSED` with the gateway's underlying ordinal codes recorded. A run that is terminal remains terminal after restart. Rule-8 table owners and SQL-driver import allowlists gain no EV exemption.

## Causal pack and public transform

Register `ev-charger/1` in the closed dispatch used by `host/execution_adapter.py`, `host/lab_execution.py` and simulator kernel, beside `cold-thermal/1`; never use fallback to fuel/mini-grid on unknown identity. Add pure pack under `simulator/assetops_simulator/packs/ev_charger.py` using the neutral `packs/errors.py:PhysicallyUnacceptable`. Start `UNPLUGGED`, no session/fault, 0 kWh. Per UTC minute apply forcing sorted `(time,connector,kind)`, with PLUG before FAULT at equal time. Plug assigns the deterministic scoped session ID; authorization lasts one minute; accepted charging emits START. Denial emits no START. Active fault emits FAULT+ABORT; pre-START fault emits FAULT only. Explicit unplug after active charge and without fault emits END. Grid loss pauses power; it never fabricates ABORT. Clear requires forcing. Available shared kW is `max(0,80-base_load)`, allocated in 1 kW round-robin quanta by connector ID with persistent pointer, bounded by request, connector and charger ratings; exact decimal `energy_next=energy+allocated_kw/60`. Guard every state transition, monotone time, finite nonnegative energy, allocation sum/limits, residual, and one START/terminal per ID. Private vehicle request/forcing/oracle remains in world data only.

`ev-publication/1` in the simulator observation/publish seam produces state on transition and each minute; connector `INTERVAL_DELTA` kWh and optional power/site import means on aligned five-minute half-open slots; session/fault events at transitions. Split boundary slots into nonoverlapping subintervals. At each boundary round cumulative kWh half-even to 0.001, subtract rounded boundaries, preserve additive total. `source_time=interval_end` for intervals. Every connector record carries nonnull `session_id,connector_id`; Site meter uses explicit null session/connector. `connector_id` equals the bound asset ID; no charger serial or customer ID becomes a session ID. W2-00 `EVENT_ID_CONFLICT`, `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`, `EV_CONNECTOR_MISMATCH`, `EV_DELTA_*` rules are unchanged. IDs are `ev-` plus lowercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON array `[scenario_sha256,device_id,signal_id,transition_ordinal]`; correlations use `ev-` plus SHA-256 of `[scenario_sha256,"session",session_id]`. They satisfy v4 `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`; only `report_key` may use `ev:` prefix, following cold's separate report-key grammar. Retransmission preserves bytes. `ev-observation/1` drops/holds/replaces public reports only; late END keeps source time/ID and publishes at 09:05. The contradictory case adds a distinct public GOOD END at 08:30 while the model emits only its genuine END at 08:31. No direct accepted-row/Finding seed.

Reuse `contracts/assetops_contracts/gateway_report.py:DeviceReportV2`; gateway `GatewayService._admit_in` remains sole v4 envelope/sequence/message allocator. Add the EV tuple matrix `(charger-controller,session-event)`, `(connector-controller,fault-event|state|requested-power|allocated-limit)`, `(connector-meter,energy|power)`, `(site-meter,import)` with exact family/kind/unit/role from design Â§3. Registered Stage sends v2 reports to `RegisteredGatewayPublisher.publish_in_boundary_order`; `GatewayService.seal,release_run,record_receipt` and SQLite outbox then authenticated Batch V2/S2 ledger carry them. Keep v1/v3 and cold canonical bytes unchanged.

### Writer, trigger and transaction contract

The 0022 generalization is mandatory before 0025. For `ev_charging`, `analytic_run.cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`; the complete Finding/Revision NOT NULL mapping and `'mini_grid'` keyed CHECKs in the cold design apply. EV FindingRevision `episode_start=START source_time`, `episode_end=ABORT source_time`; its three dispatch minute columns are null. `support_sha256` hashes sorted exact START/FAULT/ABORT evidence ID+SHA pairs, `cited_evidence_sha256` hashes the exact cited accepted set, and `input_evidence_sha256=analytic_run.input_sha256`. No fault-abort Finding is created before all three accepted facts exist.

Rule 8 `tools/checks/configuration-persistence.ps1`: add `ev_session,ev_session_revision,ev_session_evidence,ev_meter_interval` to `$assessTables` before `$assessInserts` is derived; add `ev_consequence_revision,ev_consequence_session,ev_consequence_evidence` to `$consequenceTables`, then add `ev_consequence_work,ev_consequence_work_attempt` to the same `$consequenceTables` array. `postgres_assessment_store.py` exclusively inserts the four session tables, `postgres_finding_store.py` exclusively inserts Findings, and `postgres_consequence_store.py` exclusively inserts the three EV consequence tables and appends work attempts. Migration triggers alone insert work; the consequence writer appends a `SUCCEEDED` attempt atomically with consequence/links or a `FAILED` attempt with error code. Work and attempts are append-only; runtime work INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE are rejected. Cross-writer checks cover `$consequenceTables`. `assessment_worker.py` owns one caller-supplied transaction containing analytic run, assessment, session revision/links, FindingRevision/links and job completion. `financials/recompute.py` owns a separate transaction containing consequence/links and successful work-attempt append. No SQL writer enters HTTP/domain modules and no `DO UPDATE` allowlist entry is added. The 0020 message-only conflict target, per-ordinal savepoint/reread precedence and Receipt V2 classification are inherited unchanged. `tools/writer_guard_probes.py` adds permitted owner INSERT and work-attempt append, rejects runtime work INSERT, immutable work/attempt UPDATE or DELETE, foreign owner, immutable UPDATE/DELETE, unlisted `ON CONFLICT` and dynamic SQL; it includes pass/fail probes for both multi-adapter transaction paths. The guard fails when a named module/table is missing.

`0026` adds append-only `ev_consequence_work` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, window_start/end, dirty_basis_sha256, created_at; UNIQUE `(site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256)`) and `ev_consequence_work_attempt` (`id uuid PK`, tenant/site, work_id scoped FK, attempt_no int>0, outcome `SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, error_code nullable, started_at, finished_at; UNIQUE `(work_id,attempt_no)`, partial unique successful attempt per work). Migration triggers insert dirty work on appended EV session/assessment revision, accepted late EV meter/event, tariff publication, and source-gate revision. Duplicate dirtiness uses `DO NOTHING` on the unique key inside the trigger, not a runtime writer. `postgres_consequence_store.py` selects unfinished work lacking a successful attempt, takes an advisory transaction lock per work ID, writes a Site window revision and links, and appends a `SUCCEEDED` attempt atomically; failure appends `FAILED` and remains retryable. `ev_consequence_revision.revision_no` is `1+max(revision_no)` for the locked `(tenant,site,window_start,window_end)` lineage, guarded by unique `(site_id,window_start,window_end,revision_no)` and retried on collision. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id))`, using null tariff ID text `NO_TARIFF` for unpriced revisions.

Session `reason_codes` is an array drawn only from `MISSING_START|MISSING_TERMINAL|CONFLICTING_TERMINAL|CONFLICTING_START|CONNECTOR_MISMATCH|METER_GAP|METER_OVERLAP|METER_INVALID|CLOCK_UNATTESTED|SOURCE_UNVERIFIED|PENDING_RECOMPUTE`. `links` is `{self:string|null,evidence:string|null,analysis:string|null,finding:string|null,financials:string|null}`; null means no supported destination. Foundation `readiness.state=READY_TO_REPORT|CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE`, `commissioning.state=CONFIRMED|UNCONFIRMED`, `contact.state=RECENT|STALE|NEVER`; `messages` uses exactly the codes in Â§2. +## Identity, selection and storage contract
+
+`ev_session` identity is scoped `(tenant_id,site_id,charger_asset_id,connector_asset_id,external_session_id)`, anchored to the first accepted START evidence ID and source time. An orphan terminal is retained as context in the selected read, not materialized as a started session. An accepted second START with distinct ID is a W2-00 `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`; separately accepted ENDs/ABORTs remain analytic contradictory inputs. Effective `ev-roles-1` binding resolves the connector's *single* parent charger, exact source/device/signal and Foundation at each source time. Multiple/unknown parent, wrong connector or cross-Site ID is excluded with reason, never joined by label. No session starts from PLUGGED, status or a private vehicle request.
+
+Add 0025 tables/constraints exactly as EV design §1: scoped FKs and uniqueness, positive revision, ordered nullable bounds, nonnegative finite decimal kWh/error/unknown seconds, SUPPORT interval exclusion, immutable triggers and guarded downgrade. Reuse `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `finding`, `finding_revision` and `recompute_job`; widen both Finding domain checks without loosening mini-grid/cold branches or nullable dispatch fields. For EV, `analytic_id='ev-session/1'`, `cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`. `finding.domain` and job domain are literal `ev_charging`. One fault-abort Finding key is SHA-256 of canonical tenant/Site/`EV_INTERRUPTION`/charger/connector/session/first START evidence. Finding subject is connector; START/FAULT/ABORT exact accepted IDs support the revision, its bounds are START→ABORT, dispatch minute columns null and limitation says fault observed while component cause and unmet demand remain unknown. A new basis appends a revision; a later contradiction withdraws current support without deleting the old record.
+
+For a strict selected half-open UTC `[from,to)` of at most 31 days and committed `known_at`, select accepted GOOD, clock-attested, time-valid records at that cutoff. One START, at most one nonconflicting terminal and source order within the declared 30 s cross-source error establish state. Missing terminal stays INCOMPLETE even if status turns idle. ABORT without a same-session contemporaneous fault is OBSERVED_ABORT but creates no fault-associated Finding. SUSPECT, unattested, wrong binding and ambiguous records are CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with exact reason and IDs. Basis SHA hashes sorted accepted ID+content SHA/use/reason, Foundation/binding/mapping revisions, model/rule version, exact window/cutoff and source class. Replaying the same basis is idempotent; a later END, terminal conflict, meter or source-gate change appends an immutable revision.
+
+For each started session, intersect meter `INTERVAL_DELTA` reports with `[START,terminal)` (or selected read boundary while incomplete), requiring same connector and session, GOOD clock/source and wholly contained nonoverlapping half-open interval. Reject a spanning unsplit report, overlap, negative/nonfinite delta, or `kWh > connector_max_kW × hours + 2×meter_error_bound`. Sum accepted exact Decimal deltas. Unknown seconds are the union of uncovered active five-minute slots clipped to bounds. `supported_kwh=null` with zero supported intervals; otherwise it is explicitly partial until all active slots, including split boundary slots, are covered and terminal is sound. `energy_complete=false` for incomplete/contradictory or any gap. No selected report implies zero energy; no power-integrated substitute. Status one-minute slots can give known/unknown service context but no W2 availability percentage or equipment-health conclusion. Site import below configured limit is context only, never proof that site power did or did not cause a stop.
+
+Use a caller-supplied transaction in `assessment_worker.py` + `postgres_assessment_store.py` to append analytic run, assessment, session/revision/evidence/intervals, optional Finding and links, then complete the job; rollback all on any invariant failure. Enqueue `ev_charging` on every newly accepted relevant v4 EV event, state, meter or binding/source-gate change, including late source time. Dirty the affected session/window heads with scoped joins; a failed/leased/pending overlapping job keeps current reads `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`, never silently current. Preserve exact old revision at explicit historical cutoff. A duplicate batch adds no new assessment. Do not use the stale older head for a new current claim.

+## Identity, selection and storage contract
+
+`ev_session` identity is scoped `(tenant_id,site_id,charger_asset_id,connector_asset_id,external_session_id)`, anchored to the first accepted START evidence ID and source time. An orphan terminal is retained as context in the selected read, not materialized as a started session. An accepted second START with distinct ID is a W2-00 `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`; separately accepted ENDs/ABORTs remain analytic contradictory inputs. Effective `ev-roles-1` binding resolves the connector's *single* parent charger, exact source/device/signal and Foundation at each source time. Multiple/unknown parent, wrong connector or cross-Site ID is excluded with reason, never joined by label. No session starts from PLUGGED, status or a private vehicle request.
+
+Add 0025 tables/constraints exactly as EV design §1: scoped FKs and uniqueness, positive revision, ordered nullable bounds, nonnegative finite decimal kWh/error/unknown seconds, SUPPORT interval exclusion, immutable triggers and guarded downgrade. Reuse `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `finding`, `finding_revision` and `recompute_job`; widen both Finding domain checks without loosening mini-grid/cold branches or nullable dispatch fields. For EV, `analytic_id='ev-session/1'`, `cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`. `finding.domain` and job domain are literal `ev_charging`. One fault-abort Finding key is SHA-256 of canonical tenant/Site/`EV_INTERRUPTION`/charger/connector/session/first START evidence. Finding subject is connector; START/FAULT/ABORT exact accepted IDs support the revision, its bounds are START→ABORT, dispatch minute columns null and limitation says fault observed while component cause and unmet demand remain unknown. A new basis appends a revision; a later contradiction withdraws current support without deleting the old record.
+
+For a strict selected half-open UTC `[from,to)` of at most 31 days and committed `known_at`, select accepted GOOD, clock-attested, time-valid records at that cutoff. One START, at most one nonconflicting terminal and source order within the declared 30 s cross-source error establish state. Missing terminal stays INCOMPLETE even if status turns idle. ABORT without a same-session contemporaneous fault is OBSERVED_ABORT but creates no fault-associated Finding. SUSPECT, unattested, wrong binding and ambiguous records are CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with exact reason and IDs. Basis SHA hashes sorted accepted ID+content SHA/use/reason, Foundation/binding/mapping revisions, model/rule version, exact window/cutoff and source class. Replaying the same basis is idempotent; a later END, terminal conflict, meter or source-gate change appends an immutable revision.
+
+For each started session, intersect meter `INTERVAL_DELTA` reports with `[START,terminal)` (or selected read boundary while incomplete), requiring same connector and session, GOOD clock/source and wholly contained nonoverlapping half-open interval. Reject a spanning unsplit report, overlap, negative/nonfinite delta, or `kWh > connector_max_kW × hours + 2×meter_error_bound`. Sum accepted exact Decimal deltas. Unknown seconds are the union of uncovered active five-minute slots clipped to bounds. `supported_kwh=null` with zero supported intervals; otherwise it is explicitly partial until all active slots, including split boundary slots, are covered and terminal is sound. `energy_complete=false` for incomplete/contradictory or any gap. No selected report implies zero energy; no power-integrated substitute. Status one-minute slots can give known/unknown service context but no W2 availability percentage or equipment-health conclusion. Site import below configured limit is context only, never proof that site power did or did not cause a stop.
+
+Use a caller-supplied transaction in `assessment_worker.py` + `postgres_assessment_store.py` to append analytic run, assessment, session/revision/evidence/intervals, optional Finding and links, then complete the job; rollback all on any invariant failure. Enqueue `ev_charging` on every newly accepted relevant v4 EV event, state, meter or binding/source-gate change, including late source time. Dirty the affected session/window heads with scoped joins; a failed/leased/pending overlapping job keeps current reads `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`, never silently current. Preserve exact old revision at explicit historical cutoff. A duplicate batch adds no new assessment. Do not use the stale older head for a new current claim.
