+## Identity, selection and storage contract
+
+`ev_session` identity is scoped `(tenant_id,site_id,charger_asset_id,connector_asset_id,external_session_id)`, anchored to the first accepted START evidence ID and source time. An orphan terminal is retained as context in the selected read, not materialized as a started session. An accepted second START with distinct ID is a W2-00 `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`; separately accepted ENDs/ABORTs remain analytic contradictory inputs. Effective `ev-roles-1` binding resolves the connector's *single* parent charger, exact source/device/signal and Foundation at each source time. Multiple/unknown parent, wrong connector or cross-Site ID is excluded with reason, never joined by label. No session starts from PLUGGED, status or a private vehicle request.
+
+Add 0025 tables/constraints exactly as EV design §1: scoped FKs and uniqueness, positive revision, ordered nullable bounds, nonnegative finite decimal kWh/error/unknown seconds, SUPPORT interval exclusion, immutable triggers and guarded downgrade. Reuse `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `finding`, `finding_revision` and `recompute_job`; widen both Finding domain checks without loosening mini-grid/cold branches or nullable dispatch fields. For EV, `analytic_id='ev-session/1'`, `cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`. `finding.domain` and job domain are literal `ev_charging`. One fault-abort Finding key is SHA-256 of canonical tenant/Site/`EV_INTERRUPTION`/charger/connector/session/first START evidence. Finding subject is connector; START/FAULT/ABORT exact accepted IDs support the revision, its bounds are START→ABORT, dispatch minute columns null and limitation says fault observed while component cause and unmet demand remain unknown. A new basis appends a revision; a later contradiction withdraws current support without deleting the old record.
+
+For a strict selected half-open UTC `[from,to)` of at most 31 days and committed `known_at`, select accepted GOOD, clock-attested, time-valid records at that cutoff. One START, at most one nonconflicting terminal and source order within the declared 30 s cross-source error establish state. Missing terminal stays INCOMPLETE even if status turns idle. ABORT without a same-session contemporaneous fault is OBSERVED_ABORT but creates no fault-associated Finding. SUSPECT, unattested, wrong binding and ambiguous records are CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with exact reason and IDs. Basis SHA hashes sorted accepted ID+content SHA/use/reason, Foundation/binding/mapping revisions, model/rule version, exact window/cutoff and source class. Replaying the same basis is idempotent; a later END, terminal conflict, meter or source-gate change appends an immutable revision.
+
+For each started session, intersect meter `INTERVAL_DELTA` reports with `[START,terminal)` (or selected read boundary while incomplete), requiring same connector and session, GOOD clock/source and wholly contained nonoverlapping half-open interval. Reject a spanning unsplit report, overlap, negative/nonfinite delta, or `kWh > connector_max_kW × hours + 2×meter_error_bound`. Sum accepted exact Decimal deltas. Unknown seconds are the union of uncovered active five-minute slots clipped to bounds. `supported_kwh=null` with zero supported intervals; otherwise it is explicitly partial until all active slots, including split boundary slots, are covered and terminal is sound. `energy_complete=false` for incomplete/contradictory or any gap. No selected report implies zero energy; no power-integrated substitute. Status one-minute slots can give known/unknown service context but no W2 availability percentage or equipment-health conclusion. Site import below configured limit is context only, never proof that site power did or did not cause a stop.
+
+Use a caller-supplied transaction in `assessment_worker.py` + `postgres_assessment_store.py` to append analytic run, assessment, session/revision/evidence/intervals, optional Finding and links, then complete the job; rollback all on any invariant failure. Enqueue `ev_charging` on every newly accepted relevant v4 EV event, state, meter or binding/source-gate change, including late source time. Dirty the affected session/window heads with scoped joins; a failed/leased/pending overlapping job keeps current reads `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`, never silently current. Preserve exact old revision at explicit historical cutoff. A duplicate batch adds no new assessment. Do not use the stale older head for a new current claim.
+
+## Selected API and exact UI contract
+
+Add `build_ev_assessment_router` beside `build_cold_assessment_router`, mounted from `main.py`: `/api/sites/{code}/ev/sessions`, `/sessions/{id}`, `/findings`, `/findings/{id}`. Authenticate before lookup, enforce tenant/Site/type and exact selected revision. Strict paired `from,to`, optional `known_at`, limit default 50/max 200 and opaque cursor bound to selection+basis; one bound/unknown query key/future cutoff is 422, changed basis cursor 409, wrong Site/record 404, forbidden disclosure 403, unavailable ledger 503. Valid no-record selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN`/empty. If an existing shared selection helper permits default window, its paired default is the only allowed omission; return the chosen window explicitly. Capture one committed watermark and one read snapshot; never stitch pages from a later revision. `as_of` for accepted fact is `received_at`, for assessment/Finding its stored creation time; source_time remains separate. Current status uses read-time age for latest connector state (≤2 minutes) and declared event cadence; an old closed session is historical, not live service status. Exact S4-05 class uses accepted IDs; `REGISTERED_SIMULATION` reads **Generated test data** plus the explicit registered-test explanation in UI, with class/IDs in detail.
+
+The sessions list response adds `denominator:{started,completed,observed_abort,incomplete,contradictory,orphan,as_of,limitation}` computed over the **whole selected window**, independently of pagination. START count is the denominator; an orphan count is separate. The item/detail fields are EV design §6/§8, including `energy_complete`, unknown seconds, exact evidence uses, intervals, revision history and links. Do not derive the denominator from 50 visible rows. Link an accepted record/analysis only after an integration test proves its exact target renders the selected ID with Site/window/cutoff; otherwise show labelled ID with `Analysis view not available for this EV record` as ruled by W2 retro #14. An unavailable Recommendation/Action is visible, disabled and labelled `Not available yet`, following the W2-03 mock-row ruling.

+## 0026 schema, writer and exact money calculation
+
+Migration 0026 widens only the existing `financial_assumption_revision` key/unit checks for `ev_gross_tariff_per_kwh`. Preserve diesel `currency/L`, authored/source/valid/recorded succession, correction and overlap checks, existing API authorization/idempotency and mini-grid fuel consequence check. Add EV design §1's scoped append-only `ev_consequence_revision`, `ev_consequence_session`, `ev_consequence_evidence` plus §8 `ev_consequence_work` and `_attempt`, scoped FKs/uniques, positive revision/attempt numbers, finite nonnegative Decimal checks, one success per work, triggers and guarded downgrade. `amount` is nonnull **iff** state ESTIMATED and all complete quantity/tariff/currency fields exist; `amount=quantity_kwh×tariff_value` with exact Decimal, no storage rounding. `UNPRICED`/`WITHHELD` have null amount/currency. `source_gate` is one of `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|MIXED|UNKNOWN` from S4-05, not an invented real-source class. Existing fuel consequence rows/checks stay byte-identical. Downgrade refuses while EV tariff revisions or consequences/work/history exist; no cascade deletion.
+
+One canonical Site/window consequence lineage, not a per-Finding sum: aggregate distinct included `ev_meter_interval` accepted evidence IDs across latest settled selected session revisions. For every included interval, session outcome must be COMPLETED or OBSERVED_ABORT, `energy_complete=true` across that session's active span, and no contradictory/unattested/overlap condition. An aborted session contributes only delivered pre-abort intervals; its unmet demand is unknown. Exclude incomplete sessions as *whole-session pricing* while displaying their supported partial kWh separately. At selected cutoff, each interval must be covered by exactly one tariff revision's valid range and recorded visibility; v1 requires the **same revision and currency for all included intervals**. A valid selected empty window has no eligible quantity, so `quantity_kwh=null` and no ESTIMATED zero. A tariff gap, two revisions across a window, missing tariff or unsupported unit yields `UNPRICED/PRICE_GAP_OR_CHANGE` (or `TARIFF_MISSING` for no revision) and null amount. A pending/failed/late assessment, contradictory meter, historical cutoff offered as current, source class MIXED/UNKNOWN or incoherent price/source basis yields `WITHHELD` and null current amount. A historical exact revision may display its old amount with a clear **Historical scenario** label, never as the current amount. No counterfactual sales, billing collections, margin, repair or warranty amount is computed.
+
+`technical_input_sha256` hashes sorted exact included session revision IDs/basis, accepted meter IDs+SHA, exclusion reasons and window/cutoff; `basis_sha256` additionally includes tariff revision/value/currency, source class/gate, formula `ev-gross-tariff/1`, state/reason and recorded basis. A changed selected cutoff or source/price revision appends history; identical basis is idempotent. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id_or_NO_TARIFF))`; do not count a meter interval twice through two Findings. Session link quantity is exact included kWh; evidence link is each included accepted meter ID once. Keep exact Finding link nullable because Site consequence is not owned by one Finding.
+
+Migration triggers, not runtime modules, insert dirty work when an EV session/assessment revision, accepted relevant late event/meter, EV tariff publication or source-gate publication affects a window. Scope trigger selection by tenant/Site and overlapping selected window; use `ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256) DO NOTHING` only inside trigger and test a real INSERT path. A duplicate accepted upload or identical tariff request creates no duplicate consequence. `PostgresConsequenceStore` selects work without a SUCCEEDED attempt, locks by work ID transaction advisory lock, appends next `revision_no` for the Site/window and exact links plus a SUCCEEDED attempt atomically; a failed derivation appends FAILED with code and remains retryable. No no-op fictional zero consequence is required if no qualifying session exists: an empty-ID SUCCEEDED attempt is allowed and the read says no scenario assessed. DB server timestamps are omitted by writers. Probe pass/fail Rule 8 against actual runtime modules **and the migration trigger text** (runtime scanner alone cannot prove trigger-only work). No SQL writer enters EV read service.

+## Five selected reads and source/claim vocabulary
+
+Create a pure `ev_site_reads.py` composition service with SQL kept in existing assessment/consequence/assumption adapters; mount `build_ev_site_router` from `main.py`. In one repeatable-read transaction authenticate/resolve tenant and EV Site, capture committed S2 watermark, select effective Foundation, settled W2-06 revision heads, accepted evidence/provenance and exact tariff/consequence at the same cutoff. If an adapter cannot accept a caller connection, add that method there; never compose via loopback HTTP or independently opened connections. All responses include `{site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness,source_provenance,limitations}` and EV design §6 fields. `currentness` names CURRENT, PENDING_RECOMPUTE, STALE_SOURCE, HISTORICAL or UNKNOWN according to selected basis; a historical complete technical record remains visible even when money currentness is withheld. Accepted fact age = selected `to` minus latest qualifying source time; contact is only identified source diagnostic at/before cutoff, otherwise UNKNOWN. Return exact `as_of` and limitation on each overview card. Unknown source is not “offline”; online gateway is not charger health.
+
+`/ev/overview` uses W2-06 **full-window** denominator, not a page of sessions. Energy response separates `supported_kwh`, `complete_kwh`, `partial_kwh`, `unknown_seconds`; `complete_kwh` is the eligible full-coverage session sum, while an interrupted session with complete coverage contributes delivered energy, never loss. `site_power.observed_peak_kw` is max accepted aligned import mean in covered selected slots, with configured limit and coverage; `claim_limit=CONTEXT_ONLY` unless independent requested+allocated signals and synchronized import exist, and even then competing causes remain unknown. Status is `OBSERVED_SESSIONS|NO_SESSIONS_OBSERVED|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`; do not say Healthy solely because observed peak is below cap. Attention order: pending, fault abort, incomplete session, meter/source gap, tariff missing, each with exact link if target proved. `consequence_summary` selects one latest Site/window revision by exact basis and overlap group, never sums Finding consequences.
+
+`/ev/evidence` returns capability rows in mock order, with §8 `SUPPORTED|LIMITED|UNAVAILABLE|CONTRADICTORY`, exact required/missing roles, `{known_seconds,expected_seconds,ratio}` and selected accepted IDs. Use claims SESSION_OUTCOME, SERVICE_STATE, DELIVERED_ENERGY, FAULT_ASSOCIATION for mock four rows, plus SITE_POWER_CONTEXT, POWER_CONSTRAINT and GROSS_TARIFF_SCENARIO in detail. A “Full” outcome claim requires coverage for the stated interval, not a general equipment condition. Source rows are configured c1, c2, site meter and billing system slots; billing is `Not connected` only if configuration proves absence, else `No record`. Contact from source-specific diagnostics, quality from accepted facts; no status is inferred from Site mode. Ranked next evidence is deterministic: terminal gap, meter gap, status gap, independent diagnostic/request/limit, tariff, billing; show first applicable and keep the three mock row slots with explicit `None identified` when fewer.
+
+`/ev/evidence/analysis` pages accepted public records at selected cutoff, sorted `(source_time,evidence_id)`, preserving exact event/delta value, unit, `source_time`, nullable sent/published timestamp, `received_at`, quality, role, session ID and exclusion reason. Add `value_display`, `unit`, `sent_at`, `record_target_state:PROVED|UNAVAILABLE` as W2-04 did for cold. A missing END or meter report is an explicit **gap row only when W2-06 expectation proves it**, never counted as accepted or given an invented ID. Claim-rule rows state each required role, observed/missing, coverage, result/limit, exact IDs/source class/cutoff. Exact record/assessment link requires integration proof that the target renders that ID under same Site/window/cutoff; otherwise labelled ID and `Analysis view not available for this EV record` (retro ruling #14).
+
+`/ev/financials` returns one current Site consequence with exact basis and separate explanatory `not_included:[lost_sales,collections,margin,repair,warranty]`. For no warrant/eligible interval, use one in-table empty state; do not fabricate three financial DB rows to match mock illustrations. A fault-abort row can explain delivered pre-abort kWh and unmeasured lost demand; warranty/repair row is a named **unrecorded gap**, never `$0` or `$850`. `/ev/financial-assumptions` reads actual published EV tariff revisions effective/recorded at cutoff plus `missing_keys`; billing/collections remains an unconnected capability/gap, not a publishable assumption. Currency is selected tariff currency or `Not declared`, not default USD. Both preserve selected read-only context; the existing authorized publication API creates the next time-valid tariff revision.

+## Identity, selection and storage contract
+
+`ev_session` identity is scoped `(tenant_id,site_id,charger_asset_id,connector_asset_id,external_session_id)`, anchored to the first accepted START evidence ID and source time. An orphan terminal is retained as context in the selected read, not materialized as a started session. An accepted second START with distinct ID is a W2-00 `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`; separately accepted ENDs/ABORTs remain analytic contradictory inputs. Effective `ev-roles-1` binding resolves the connector's *single* parent charger, exact source/device/signal and Foundation at each source time. Multiple/unknown parent, wrong connector or cross-Site ID is excluded with reason, never joined by label. No session starts from PLUGGED, status or a private vehicle request.

+Add 0025 tables/constraints exactly as EV design §1: scoped FKs and uniqueness, positive revision, ordered nullable bounds, nonnegative finite decimal kWh/error/unknown seconds, SUPPORT interval exclusion, immutable triggers and guarded downgrade. One fault-abort Finding key is SHA-256 of canonical tenant/Site/`EV_INTERRUPTION`/charger/connector/session/first START evidence. Finding subject is connector; START/FAULT/ABORT exact accepted IDs support the revision, its bounds are START→ABORT, dispatch minute columns null and limitation says fault observed while component cause and unmet demand remain unknown. A new basis appends a revision; a later contradiction withdraws current support without deleting the old record.
+
+For a strict selected half-open UTC `[from,to)` of at most 31 days and committed `known_at`, select accepted GOOD, clock-attested, time-valid records at that cutoff. One START, at most one nonconflicting terminal and source order within the declared 30 s cross-source error establish state. Missing terminal stays INCOMPLETE even if status turns idle. ABORT without a same-session contemporaneous fault is OBSERVED_ABORT but creates no fault-associated Finding. SUSPECT, unattested, wrong binding and ambiguous records are CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with exact reason and IDs. Basis SHA hashes sorted accepted ID+content SHA/use/reason, Foundation/binding/mapping revisions, model/rule version, exact window/cutoff and source class. Replaying the same basis is idempotent; a later END, terminal conflict, meter or source-gate change appends an immutable revision.

+For each started session, intersect meter `INTERVAL_DELTA` reports with `[START,terminal)` (or selected read boundary while incomplete), requiring same connector and session, GOOD clock/source and wholly contained nonoverlapping half-open interval. Reject a spanning unsplit report, overlap, negative/nonfinite delta, or `kWh > connector_max_kW × hours + 2×meter_error_bound`. Sum accepted exact Decimal deltas. Unknown seconds are the union of uncovered active five-minute slots clipped to bounds. `supported_kwh=null` with zero supported intervals; otherwise it is explicitly partial until all active slots, including split boundary slots, are covered and terminal is sound. `energy_complete=false` for incomplete/contradictory or any gap. No selected report implies zero energy; no power-integrated substitute. Status one-minute slots can give known/unknown service context but no W2 availability percentage or equipment-health conclusion. Site import below configured limit is context only, never proof that site power did or did not cause a stop.

Enqueue `ev_charging` on every newly accepted relevant v4 EV event, state, meter or binding/source-gate change, including late source time. Dirty the affected session/window heads with scoped joins; a failed/leased/pending overlapping job keeps current reads `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`, never silently current. Preserve exact old revision at explicit historical cutoff. A duplicate batch adds no new assessment. Do not use the stale older head for a new current claim.

+## 0026 schema, writer and exact money calculation
+
+Migration 0026 widens only the existing `financial_assumption_revision` key/unit checks for `ev_gross_tariff_per_kwh`. Preserve diesel `currency/L`, authored/source/valid/recorded succession, correction and overlap checks, existing API authorization/idempotency and mini-grid fuel consequence check. Add EV design §1's scoped append-only `ev_consequence_revision`, `ev_consequence_session`, `ev_consequence_evidence` plus §8 `ev_consequence_work` and `_attempt`, scoped FKs/uniques, positive revision/attempt numbers, finite nonnegative Decimal checks, one success per work, triggers and guarded downgrade. `amount` is nonnull **iff** state ESTIMATED and all complete quantity/tariff/currency fields exist; `amount=quantity_kwh×tariff_value` with exact Decimal, no storage rounding. `UNPRICED`/`WITHHELD` have null amount/currency. `source_gate` is one of `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|MIXED|UNKNOWN` from S4-05, not an invented real-source class. Existing fuel consequence rows/checks stay byte-identical. Downgrade refuses while EV tariff revisions or consequences/work/history exist; no cascade deletion.
+
+One canonical Site/window consequence lineage, not a per-Finding sum: aggregate distinct included `ev_meter_interval` accepted evidence IDs across latest settled selected session revisions. For every included interval, session outcome must be COMPLETED or OBSERVED_ABORT, `energy_complete=true` across that session's active span, and no contradictory/unattested/overlap condition. An aborted session contributes only delivered pre-abort intervals; its unmet demand is unknown. Exclude incomplete sessions as *whole-session pricing* while displaying their supported partial kWh separately. At selected cutoff, each interval must be covered by exactly one tariff revision's valid range and recorded visibility; v1 requires the **same revision and currency for all included intervals**. A valid selected empty window has no eligible quantity, so `quantity_kwh=null` and no ESTIMATED zero. A tariff gap, two revisions across a window, missing tariff or unsupported unit yields `UNPRICED/PRICE_GAP_OR_CHANGE` (or `TARIFF_MISSING` for no revision) and null amount. A pending/failed/late assessment, contradictory meter, historical cutoff offered as current, source class MIXED/UNKNOWN or incoherent price/source basis yields `WITHHELD` and null current amount. A historical exact revision may display its old amount with a clear **Historical scenario** label, never as the current amount. No counterfactual sales, billing collections, margin, repair or warranty amount is computed.
+
+`technical_input_sha256` hashes sorted exact included session revision IDs/basis, accepted meter IDs+SHA, exclusion reasons and window/cutoff; `basis_sha256` additionally includes tariff revision/value/currency, source class/gate, formula `ev-gross-tariff/1`, state/reason and recorded basis. A changed selected cutoff or source/price revision appends history; identical basis is idempotent. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id_or_NO_TARIFF))`; do not count a meter interval twice through two Findings. Session link quantity is exact included kWh; evidence link is each included accepted meter ID once. Keep exact Finding link nullable because Site consequence is not owned by one Finding.
+
+Migration triggers, not runtime modules, insert dirty work when an EV session/assessment revision, accepted relevant late event/meter, EV tariff publication or source-gate publication affects a window. Scope trigger selection by tenant/Site and overlapping selected window; use `ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256) DO NOTHING` only inside trigger and test a real INSERT path. A duplicate accepted upload or identical tariff request creates no duplicate consequence. `PostgresConsequenceStore` selects work without a SUCCEEDED attempt, locks by work ID transaction advisory lock, appends next `revision_no` for the Site/window and exact links plus a SUCCEEDED attempt atomically; a failed derivation appends FAILED with code and remains retryable. No no-op fictional zero consequence is required if no qualifying session exists: an empty-ID SUCCEEDED attempt is allowed and the read says no scenario assessed. DB server timestamps are omitted by writers. Probe pass/fail Rule 8 against actual runtime modules **and the migration trigger text** (runtime scanner alone cannot prove trigger-only work). No SQL writer enters EV read service.

# Planning Guidance

## Purpose

Before implementation tasks are defined, the Architect should establish a feature
map for the first AssetOps product sequence. The feature map should explain how
visible UI capabilities depend on product, domain, data, and architecture
capabilities.

Do not start by listing implementation tasks. Start by understanding the screens
and the causal prerequisites that make them truthful.

## Source Material

For this replan, direction comes only from `Docs/simulator_design_v4.md`
(mechanisms) and `Docs/mini-grid-demo-architecture-and-roadmap.md` (demo path).
This replaces the previous instruction to start sequencing from UI references.

`.ai/FEATURE_MAP.md` maps the corrected sources onto the built-state record.
Read `.ai/CODE_STATE.md` and completed tasks for what exists, not earlier
planning reviews for direction. Existing canonical UI layouts remain useful
presentation constraints; they cannot invent capability or reorder the demo.

## Architect Hats

The Architect may wear these hats as needed:

- Product: define what user-visible capability each feature provides.
- Architecture: identify durable boundaries, contracts, and dependency
  direction.
- UI/UX: identify screen flows, information hierarchy, and user-verifiable
  states.
- Domain: identify site, component, device, simulator, gateway, evidence, and
  operational semantics.

These are hats for analysis, not separate standing roles.

## Core Planning Principle

Plan features in causal order.

If a screen displays a fact, state, or diagram, identify what must exist before
that display can be meaningful. Then decide whether that prerequisite should be
its own UI-verifiable slice or part of a larger slice.

For example, the Simulator Lab screen shows site information, a single-line
diagram, devices and sensors, gateway output, events, run state, and simulation
controls. Those features imply earlier or parallel capabilities:

- Sites must be managed before a simulator run can target a site.
- Site components must be configured before a single-line diagram can be shown.
- Devices and sensors must be defined before device tables or gateway output can
  be meaningful.
- Scenario and event definitions must exist before scheduled events or injected
  events can be shown.
- Simulator run state must remain separate from product evidence until an
  observation is published through a boundary.
- Site Details can show operational evidence only after the evidence contract
  exists.

## Feature Versus Task

A feature is a complete product function or capability that a user can recognize
across one or more screens. A feature may require several tasks before it is
complete.

A task is a reviewable implementation slice that delivers or materially advances
one UI-verifiable part of a feature. A task should be small enough to implement
and review independently, but it does not need to complete the whole feature.

All responses include `{site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness,source_provenance,limitations}` and EV design §6 fields. `currentness` names CURRENT, PENDING_RECOMPUTE, STALE_SOURCE, HISTORICAL or UNKNOWN according to selected basis; a historical complete technical record remains visible even when money currentness is withheld. Accepted fact age = selected `to` minus latest qualifying source time; contact is only identified source diagnostic at/before cutoff, otherwise UNKNOWN. Return exact `as_of` and limitation on each overview card. Unknown source is not “offline”; online gateway is not charger health.
+
+`/ev/overview` uses W2-06 **full-window** denominator, not a page of sessions. Energy response separates `supported_kwh`, `complete_kwh`, `partial_kwh`, `unknown_seconds`; `complete_kwh` is the eligible full-coverage session sum, while an interrupted session with complete coverage contributes delivered energy, never loss. `site_power.observed_peak_kw` is max accepted aligned import mean in covered selected slots, with configured limit and coverage; `claim_limit=CONTEXT_ONLY` unless independent requested+allocated signals and synchronized import exist, and even then competing causes remain unknown. Status is `OBSERVED_SESSIONS|NO_SESSIONS_OBSERVED|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY`; do not say Healthy solely because observed peak is below cap. Attention order: pending, fault abort, incomplete session, meter/source gap, tariff missing, each with exact link if target proved. `consequence_summary` selects one latest Site/window revision by exact basis and overlap group, never sums Finding consequences.
+
+`/ev/evidence` returns capability rows in mock order, with §8 `SUPPORTED|LIMITED|UNAVAILABLE|CONTRADICTORY`, exact required/missing roles, `{known_seconds,expected_seconds,ratio}` and selected accepted IDs. Use claims SESSION_OUTCOME, SERVICE_STATE, DELIVERED_ENERGY, FAULT_ASSOCIATION for mock four rows, plus SITE_POWER_CONTEXT, POWER_CONSTRAINT and GROSS_TARIFF_SCENARIO in detail. A “Full” outcome claim requires coverage for the stated interval, not a general equipment condition. Source rows are configured c1, c2, site meter and billing system slots; billing is `Not connected` only if configuration proves absence, else `No record`. Contact from source-specific diagnostics, quality from accepted facts; no status is inferred from Site mode. Ranked next evidence is deterministic: terminal gap, meter gap, status gap, independent diagnostic/request/limit, tariff, billing; show first applicable and keep the three mock row slots with explicit `None identified` when fewer.
+
+`/ev/evidence/analysis` pages accepted public records at selected cutoff, sorted `(source_time,evidence_id)`, preserving exact event/delta value, unit, `source_time`, nullable sent/published timestamp, `received_at`, quality, role, session ID and exclusion reason. Add `value_display`, `unit`, `sent_at`, `record_target_state:PROVED|UNAVAILABLE` as W2-04 did for cold. A missing END or meter report is an explicit **gap row only when W2-06 expectation proves it**, never counted as accepted or given an invented ID. Claim-rule rows state each required role, observed/missing, coverage, result/limit, exact IDs/source class/cutoff. Exact record/assessment link requires integration proof that the target renders that ID under same Site/window/cutoff; otherwise labelled ID and `Analysis view not available for this EV record` (retro ruling #14).
+
+`/ev/financials` returns one current Site consequence with exact basis and separate explanatory `not_included:[lost_sales,collections,margin,repair,warranty]`. For no warrant/eligible interval, use one in-table empty state; do not fabricate three financial DB rows to match mock illustrations. A fault-abort row can explain delivered pre-abort kWh and unmeasured lost demand; warranty/repair row is a named **unrecorded gap**, never `$0` or `$850`. `/ev/financial-assumptions` reads actual published EV tariff revisions effective/recorded at cutoff plus `missing_keys`; billing/collections remains an unconnected capability/gap, not a publishable assumption. Currency is selected tariff currency or `Not declared`, not default USD. Both preserve selected read-only context; the existing authorized publication API creates the next time-valid tariff revision.
+

+## Identity, selection and storage contract
+
+`ev_session` identity is scoped `(tenant_id,site_id,charger_asset_id,connector_asset_id,external_session_id)`, anchored to the first accepted START evidence ID and source time. An orphan terminal is retained as context in the selected read, not materialized as a started session. Effective `ev-roles-1` binding resolves the connector's *single* parent charger, exact source/device/signal and Foundation at each source time. Multiple/unknown parent, wrong connector or cross-Site ID is excluded with reason, never joined by label. No session starts from PLUGGED, status or a private vehicle request.

+Add 0025 tables/constraints exactly as EV design §1: scoped FKs and uniqueness, positive revision, ordered nullable bounds, nonnegative finite decimal kWh/error/unknown seconds, SUPPORT interval exclusion, immutable triggers and guarded downgrade. Reuse `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `finding`, `finding_revision` and `recompute_job`; widen both Finding domain checks without loosening mini-grid/cold branches or nullable dispatch fields. For EV, `analytic_id='ev-session/1'`, `cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`. `finding.domain` and job domain are literal `ev_charging`. One fault-abort Finding key is SHA-256 of canonical tenant/Site/`EV_INTERRUPTION`/charger/connector/session/first START evidence. Finding subject is connector; START/FAULT/ABORT exact accepted IDs support the revision, its bounds are START→ABORT, dispatch minute columns null and limitation says fault observed while component cause and unmet demand remain unknown. A new basis appends a revision; a later contradiction withdraws current support without deleting the old record.
+
+For a strict selected half-open UTC `[from,to)` of at most 31 days and committed `known_at`, select accepted GOOD, clock-attested, time-valid records at that cutoff. One START, at most one nonconflicting terminal and source order within the declared 30 s cross-source error establish state. Missing terminal stays INCOMPLETE even if status turns idle. ABORT without a same-session contemporaneous fault is OBSERVED_ABORT but creates no fault-associated Finding. SUSPECT, unattested, wrong binding and ambiguous records are CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with exact reason and IDs. Basis SHA hashes sorted accepted ID+content SHA/use/reason, Foundation/binding/mapping revisions, model/rule version, exact window/cutoff and source class. Replaying the same basis is idempotent; a later END, terminal conflict, meter or source-gate change appends an immutable revision.
+
+For each started session, intersect meter `INTERVAL_DELTA` reports with `[START,terminal)` (or selected read boundary while incomplete), requiring same connector and session, GOOD clock/source and wholly contained nonoverlapping half-open interval. Reject a spanning unsplit report, overlap, negative/nonfinite delta, or `kWh > connector_max_kW × hours + 2×meter_error_bound`. Sum accepted exact Decimal deltas. Unknown seconds are the union of uncovered active five-minute slots clipped to bounds. `supported_kwh=null` with zero supported intervals; otherwise it is explicitly partial until all active slots, including split boundary slots, are covered and terminal is sound. `energy_complete=false` for incomplete/contradictory or any gap. No selected report implies zero energy; no power-integrated substitute. Status one-minute slots can give known/unknown service context but no W2 availability percentage or equipment-health conclusion. Site import below configured limit is context only, never proof that site power did or did not cause a stop.
+
+Use a caller-supplied transaction in `assessment_worker.py` + `postgres_assessment_store.py` to append analytic run, assessment, session/revision/evidence/intervals, optional Finding and links, then complete the job; rollback all on any invariant failure. Enqueue `ev_charging` on every newly accepted relevant v4 EV event, state, meter or binding/source-gate change, including late source time. Dirty the affected session/window heads with scoped joins; a failed/leased/pending overlapping job keeps current reads `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`, never silently current. Preserve exact old revision at explicit historical cutoff. A duplicate batch adds no new assessment. Do not use the stale older head for a new current claim.
+
+## Selected API and exact UI contract
+
+Add `build_ev_assessment_router` beside `build_cold_assessment_router`, mounted from `main.py`: `/api/sites/{code}/ev/sessions`, `/sessions/{id}`, `/findings`, `/findings/{id}`. Authenticate before lookup, enforce tenant/Site/type and exact selected revision. Strict paired `from,to`, optional `known_at`, limit default 50/max 200 and opaque cursor bound to selection+basis; one bound/unknown query key/future cutoff is 422, changed basis cursor 409, wrong Site/record 404, forbidden disclosure 403, unavailable ledger 503. Valid no-record selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN`/empty. If an existing shared selection helper permits default window, its paired default is the only allowed omission; return the chosen window explicitly. Capture one committed watermark and one read snapshot; never stitch pages from a later revision. `as_of` for accepted fact is `received_at`, for assessment/Finding its stored creation time; source_time remains separate. Current status uses read-time age for latest connector state (≤2 minutes) and declared event cadence; an old closed session is historical, not live service status. Exact S4-05 class uses accepted IDs; `REGISTERED_SIMULATION` reads **Generated test data** plus the explicit registered-test explanation in UI, with class/IDs in detail.
+
+The sessions list response adds `denominator:{started,completed,observed_abort,incomplete,contradictory,orphan,as_of,limitation}` computed over the **whole selected window**, independently of pagination. START count is the denominator; an orphan count is separate. The item/detail fields are EV design §6/§8, including `energy_complete`, unknown seconds, exact evidence uses, intervals, revision history and links. Do not derive the denominator from 50 visible rows. Link an accepted record/analysis only after an integration test proves its exact target renders the selected ID with Site/window/cutoff; otherwise show labelled ID with `Analysis view not available for this EV record` as ruled by W2 retro #14. An unavailable Recommendation/Action is visible, disabled and labelled `Not available yet`, following the W2-03 mock-row ruling.

For EV, `analytic_id='ev-session/1'`, `cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`. `finding.domain` and job domain are literal `ev_charging`. One fault-abort Finding key is SHA-256 of canonical tenant/Site/`EV_INTERRUPTION`/charger/connector/session/first START evidence. Finding subject is connector; START/FAULT/ABORT exact accepted IDs support the revision, its bounds are START→ABORT, dispatch minute columns null and limitation says fault observed while component cause and unmet demand remain unknown. A new basis appends a revision; a later contradiction withdraws current support without deleting the old record.
+
+For a strict selected half-open UTC `[from,to)` of at most 31 days and committed `known_at`, select accepted GOOD, clock-attested, time-valid records at that cutoff. One START, at most one nonconflicting terminal and source order within the declared 30 s cross-source error establish state. Missing terminal stays INCOMPLETE even if status turns idle. ABORT without a same-session contemporaneous fault is OBSERVED_ABORT but creates no fault-associated Finding. SUSPECT, unattested, wrong binding and ambiguous records are CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with exact reason and IDs. Basis SHA hashes sorted accepted ID+content SHA/use/reason, Foundation/binding/mapping revisions, model/rule version, exact window/cutoff and source class. Replaying the same basis is idempotent; a later END, terminal conflict, meter or source-gate change appends an immutable revision.
+
+For each started session, intersect meter `INTERVAL_DELTA` reports with `[START,terminal)` (or selected read boundary while incomplete), requiring same connector and session, GOOD clock/source and wholly contained nonoverlapping half-open interval. Reject a spanning unsplit report, overlap, negative/nonfinite delta, or `kWh > connector_max_kW × hours + 2×meter_error_bound`. Sum accepted exact Decimal deltas. Unknown seconds are the union of uncovered active five-minute slots clipped to bounds. `supported_kwh=null` with zero supported intervals; otherwise it is explicitly partial until all active slots, including split boundary slots, are covered and terminal is sound. `energy_complete=false` for incomplete/contradictory or any gap. No selected report implies zero energy; no power-integrated substitute. Status one-minute slots can give known/unknown service context but no W2 availability percentage or equipment-health conclusion. Site import below configured limit is context only, never proof that site power did or did not cause a stop.
+
+Use a caller-supplied transaction in `assessment_worker.py` + `postgres_assessment_store.py` to append analytic run, assessment, session/revision/evidence/intervals, optional Finding and links, then complete the job; rollback all on any invariant failure. Enqueue `ev_charging` on every newly accepted relevant v4 EV event, state, meter or binding/source-gate change, including late source time. Dirty the affected session/window heads with scoped joins; a failed/leased/pending overlapping job keeps current reads `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`, never silently current. Preserve exact old revision at explicit historical cutoff. A duplicate batch adds no new assessment. Do not use the stale older head for a new current claim.
+
+## Selected API and exact UI contract
+
+Add `build_ev_assessment_router` beside `build_cold_assessment_router`, mounted from `main.py`: `/api/sites/{code}/ev/sessions`, `/sessions/{id}`, `/findings`, `/findings/{id}`. Authenticate before lookup, enforce tenant/Site/type and exact selected revision. Strict paired `from,to`, optional `known_at`, limit default 50/max 200 and opaque cursor bound to selection+basis; one bound/unknown query key/future cutoff is 422, changed basis cursor 409, wrong Site/record 404, forbidden disclosure 403, unavailable ledger 503. Valid no-record selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN`/empty. If an existing shared selection helper permits default window, its paired default is the only allowed omission; return the chosen window explicitly. Capture one committed watermark and one read snapshot; never stitch pages from a later revision. `as_of` for accepted fact is `received_at`, for assessment/Finding its stored creation time; source_time remains separate. Current status uses read-time age for latest connector state (≤2 minutes) and declared event cadence; an old closed session is historical, not live service status. Exact S4-05 class uses accepted IDs; `REGISTERED_SIMULATION` reads **Generated test data** plus the explicit registered-test explanation in UI, with class/IDs in detail.
+
+The sessions list response adds `denominator:{started,completed,observed_abort,incomplete,contradictory,orphan,as_of,limitation}` computed over the **whole selected window**, independently of pagination. START count is the denominator; an orphan count is separate. The item/detail fields are EV design §6/§8, including `energy_complete`, unknown seconds, exact evidence uses, intervals, revision history and links. Do not derive the denominator from 50 visible rows. Link an accepted record/analysis only after an integration test proves its exact target renders the selected ID with Site/window/cutoff; otherwise show labelled ID with `Analysis view not available for this EV record` as ruled by W2 retro #14. An unavailable Recommendation/Action is visible, disabled and labelled `Not available yet`, following the W2-03 mock-row ruling.

+## 0026 schema, writer and exact money calculation
+
+Migration 0026 widens only the existing `financial_assumption_revision` key/unit checks for `ev_gross_tariff_per_kwh`. Preserve diesel `currency/L`, authored/source/valid/recorded succession, correction and overlap checks, existing API authorization/idempotency and mini-grid fuel consequence check. Add EV design §1's scoped append-only `ev_consequence_revision`, `ev_consequence_session`, `ev_consequence_evidence` plus §8 `ev_consequence_work` and `_attempt`, scoped FKs/uniques, positive revision/attempt numbers, finite nonnegative Decimal checks, one success per work, triggers and guarded downgrade. `amount` is nonnull **iff** state ESTIMATED and all complete quantity/tariff/currency fields exist; `amount=quantity_kwh×tariff_value` with exact Decimal, no storage rounding. `UNPRICED`/`WITHHELD` have null amount/currency. `source_gate` is one of `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|MIXED|UNKNOWN` from S4-05, not an invented real-source class. Existing fuel consequence rows/checks stay byte-identical. Downgrade refuses while EV tariff revisions or consequences/work/history exist; no cascade deletion.
+
+One canonical Site/window consequence lineage, not a per-Finding sum: aggregate distinct included `ev_meter_interval` accepted evidence IDs across latest settled selected session revisions. For every included interval, session outcome must be COMPLETED or OBSERVED_ABORT, `energy_complete=true` across that session's active span, and no contradictory/unattested/overlap condition. An aborted session contributes only delivered pre-abort intervals; its unmet demand is unknown. Exclude incomplete sessions as *whole-session pricing* while displaying their supported partial kWh separately. At selected cutoff, each interval must be covered by exactly one tariff revision's valid range and recorded visibility; v1 requires the **same revision and currency for all included intervals**. A valid selected empty window has no eligible quantity, so `quantity_kwh=null` and no ESTIMATED zero. A tariff gap, two revisions across a window, missing tariff or unsupported unit yields `UNPRICED/PRICE_GAP_OR_CHANGE` (or `TARIFF_MISSING` for no revision) and null amount. A pending/failed/late assessment, contradictory meter, historical cutoff offered as current, source class MIXED/UNKNOWN or incoherent price/source basis yields `WITHHELD` and null current amount. A historical exact revision may display its old amount with a clear **Historical scenario** label, never as the current amount. No counterfactual sales, billing collections, margin, repair or warranty amount is computed.
+
+`technical_input_sha256` hashes sorted exact included session revision IDs/basis, accepted meter IDs+SHA, exclusion reasons and window/cutoff; `basis_sha256` additionally includes tariff revision/value/currency, source class/gate, formula `ev-gross-tariff/1`, state/reason and recorded basis. A changed selected cutoff or source/price revision appends history; identical basis is idempotent. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id_or_NO_TARIFF))`; do not count a meter interval twice through two Findings. Session link quantity is exact included kWh; evidence link is each included accepted meter ID once. Keep exact Finding link nullable because Site consequence is not owned by one Finding.
+
+Migration triggers, not runtime modules, insert dirty work when an EV session/assessment revision, accepted relevant late event/meter, EV tariff publication or source-gate publication affects a window. Scope trigger selection by tenant/Site and overlapping selected window; use `ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256) DO NOTHING` only inside trigger and test a real INSERT path. A duplicate accepted upload or identical tariff request creates no duplicate consequence. `PostgresConsequenceStore` selects work without a SUCCEEDED attempt, locks by work ID transaction advisory lock, appends next `revision_no` for the Site/window and exact links plus a SUCCEEDED attempt atomically; a failed derivation appends FAILED with code and remains retryable. No no-op fictional zero consequence is required if no qualifying session exists: an empty-ID SUCCEEDED attempt is allowed and the read says no scenario assessed. DB server timestamps are omitted by writers. Probe pass/fail Rule 8 against actual runtime modules **and the migration trigger text** (runtime scanner alone cannot prove trigger-only work). No SQL writer enters EV read service.

frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:29:`foundation_revision` holds the public Site definition, not simulated world inputs. `signal_binding_revision` is both the server's registered gateway mapping and the semantic role binding; gateway downloads an immutable versioned snapshot with a canonical content hash over an authenticated channel. frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:177:1. **Register configuration.** Publish Foundation and SignalBinding versions together under Site lock. Validate site type, role vocabulary, units, asset ownership and non-overlapping current valid periods. frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:179:3. **Decide records.** In one Postgres transaction, lock batch row; for each unprocessed ordinal parse strict envelope, verify identity/sequence and referenced mapping/Foundation validity at `source_time`, normalize with the registered as-accepted conversion, and insert acceptance or rejection plus disposition. Unique message key arbitrates concurrent duplicate deliveries. Equal digest is `DUPLICATE`; changed digest is `CONFLICT` and points to first accepted evidence. Update watermark and create/coalesce recompute jobs in the same commit. Chunk a large batch into short committed transactions; receipt exposes `IN_PROGRESS` until all ordinals are durable. A client retries the same batch/bytes and resumes from the persisted watermark. Return a terminal receipt only after all decisions commit.
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:180:4. **Assess.** Worker leases dirty site/domain/window jobs, selects accepted evidence by source time plus interval overlap at a declared knowledge cutoff, resolves the exact public configuration, builds `AnalyticInputSet`, and runs the versioned pure analytic. In one commit insert `AnalyticRun`, immutable assessment/finding/consequence revisions when basis changed, update projections and mark job done. Retry of same input hash is a no-op. Late or out-of-order evidence recomputes the affected and neighboring continuity window; it never mutates old revisions. Model deployment schedules explicit re-evaluation of supported windows.
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:181:5. **Verify.** ActionEvent records work. After a later closed window exists, evaluate the frozen plan against accepted evidence, target and each guardrail. Missing coverage is `INCONCLUSIVE`; worsening service prevents `VERIFIED` even if cost falls. Link outcome to exact analytic run/evidence and surface any later superseding outcome.
frontend/docs/architecture/production-shaped-mvp-technical-design.md:185:**Gateway diagnostic API:** `POST /api/gateways/{gateway_id}/diagnostics` authenticates the registered gateway/site, checks `GatewayDiagnosticsV1` identity/hash and inserts `gateway_diagnostic` with server `received_at`; an identical retry returns the existing row. `409` refuses identity reuse with different bytes, `422` malformed fields, and `401/403` wrong credential/scope. `GET /api/sites/{id}/gateway-health` returns last server contact, declared cadence, source-contact observations, queue age/depth, disk pressure, clock offset and an explicit `CURRENT|STALE|UNKNOWN` status with diagnostic ID and receive time. It makes no claim that the device or asset itself is healthy. S2-01c publishes locally; S2-02 owns central storage and read API; S7 composes the Site Health claim.

+## Identity, selection and storage contract
+
+`ev_session` identity is scoped `(tenant_id,site_id,charger_asset_id,connector_asset_id,external_session_id)`, anchored to the first accepted START evidence ID and source time. An orphan terminal is retained as context in the selected read, not materialized as a started session. An accepted second START with distinct ID is a W2-00 `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`; separately accepted ENDs/ABORTs remain analytic contradictory inputs. Effective `ev-roles-1` binding resolves the connector's *single* parent charger, exact source/device/signal and Foundation at each source time. Multiple/unknown parent, wrong connector or cross-Site ID is excluded with reason, never joined by label. No session starts from PLUGGED, status or a private vehicle request.
+
+Add 0025 tables/constraints exactly as EV design §1: scoped FKs and uniqueness, positive revision, ordered nullable bounds, nonnegative finite decimal kWh/error/unknown seconds, SUPPORT interval exclusion, immutable triggers and guarded downgrade. Reuse `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `finding`, `finding_revision` and `recompute_job`; widen both Finding domain checks without loosening mini-grid/cold branches or nullable dispatch fields. For EV, `analytic_id='ev-session/1'`, `cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`. `finding.domain` and job domain are literal `ev_charging`. One fault-abort Finding key is SHA-256 of canonical tenant/Site/`EV_INTERRUPTION`/charger/connector/session/first START evidence. Finding subject is connector; START/FAULT/ABORT exact accepted IDs support the revision, its bounds are START→ABORT, dispatch minute columns null and limitation says fault observed while component cause and unmet demand remain unknown. A new basis appends a revision; a later contradiction withdraws current support without deleting the old record.
+
+For a strict selected half-open UTC `[from,to)` of at most 31 days and committed `known_at`, select accepted GOOD, clock-attested, time-valid records at that cutoff. One START, at most one nonconflicting terminal and source order within the declared 30 s cross-source error establish state. Missing terminal stays INCOMPLETE even if status turns idle. ABORT without a same-session contemporaneous fault is OBSERVED_ABORT but creates no fault-associated Finding. SUSPECT, unattested, wrong binding and ambiguous records are CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with exact reason and IDs. Basis SHA hashes sorted accepted ID+content SHA/use/reason, Foundation/binding/mapping revisions, model/rule version, exact window/cutoff and source class. Replaying the same basis is idempotent; a later END, terminal conflict, meter or source-gate change appends an immutable revision.
+
+For each started session, intersect meter `INTERVAL_DELTA` reports with `[START,terminal)` (or selected read boundary while incomplete), requiring same connector and session, GOOD clock/source and wholly contained nonoverlapping half-open interval. Reject a spanning unsplit report, overlap, negative/nonfinite delta, or `kWh > connector_max_kW × hours + 2×meter_error_bound`. Sum accepted exact Decimal deltas. Unknown seconds are the union of uncovered active five-minute slots clipped to bounds. `supported_kwh=null` with zero supported intervals; otherwise it is explicitly partial until all active slots, including split boundary slots, are covered and terminal is sound. `energy_complete=false` for incomplete/contradictory or any gap. No selected report implies zero energy; no power-integrated substitute. Status one-minute slots can give known/unknown service context but no W2 availability percentage or equipment-health conclusion. Site import below configured limit is context only, never proof that site power did or did not cause a stop.
+
+Use a caller-supplied transaction in `assessment_worker.py` + `postgres_assessment_store.py` to append analytic run, assessment, session/revision/evidence/intervals, optional Finding and links, then complete the job; rollback all on any invariant failure. Enqueue `ev_charging` on every newly accepted relevant v4 EV event, state, meter or binding/source-gate change, including late source time. Dirty the affected session/window heads with scoped joins; a failed/leased/pending overlapping job keeps current reads `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`, never silently current. Preserve exact old revision at explicit historical cutoff. A duplicate batch adds no new assessment. Do not use the stale older head for a new current claim.

+## 0026 schema, writer and exact money calculation
+
+Migration 0026 widens only the existing `financial_assumption_revision` key/unit checks for `ev_gross_tariff_per_kwh`. Preserve diesel `currency/L`, authored/source/valid/recorded succession, correction and overlap checks, existing API authorization/idempotency and mini-grid fuel consequence check. Add EV design §1's scoped append-only `ev_consequence_revision`, `ev_consequence_session`, `ev_consequence_evidence` plus §8 `ev_consequence_work` and `_attempt`, scoped FKs/uniques, positive revision/attempt numbers, finite nonnegative Decimal checks, one success per work, triggers and guarded downgrade. `amount` is nonnull **iff** state ESTIMATED and all complete quantity/tariff/currency fields exist; `amount=quantity_kwh×tariff_value` with exact Decimal, no storage rounding. `UNPRICED`/`WITHHELD` have null amount/currency. `source_gate` is one of `AUTHORED_DEMONSTRATION|REGISTERED_SIMULATION|MIXED|UNKNOWN` from S4-05, not an invented real-source class. Existing fuel consequence rows/checks stay byte-identical. Downgrade refuses while EV tariff revisions or consequences/work/history exist; no cascade deletion.
+
+One canonical Site/window consequence lineage, not a per-Finding sum: aggregate distinct included `ev_meter_interval` accepted evidence IDs across latest settled selected session revisions. For every included interval, session outcome must be COMPLETED or OBSERVED_ABORT, `energy_complete=true` across that session's active span, and no contradictory/unattested/overlap condition. An aborted session contributes only delivered pre-abort intervals; its unmet demand is unknown. Exclude incomplete sessions as *whole-session pricing* while displaying their supported partial kWh separately. At selected cutoff, each interval must be covered by exactly one tariff revision's valid range and recorded visibility; v1 requires the **same revision and currency for all included intervals**. A valid selected empty window has no eligible quantity, so `quantity_kwh=null` and no ESTIMATED zero. A tariff gap, two revisions across a window, missing tariff or unsupported unit yields `UNPRICED/PRICE_GAP_OR_CHANGE` (or `TARIFF_MISSING` for no revision) and null amount. A pending/failed/late assessment, contradictory meter, historical cutoff offered as current, source class MIXED/UNKNOWN or incoherent price/source basis yields `WITHHELD` and null current amount. A historical exact revision may display its old amount with a clear **Historical scenario** label, never as the current amount. No counterfactual sales, billing collections, margin, repair or warranty amount is computed.

+`technical_input_sha256` hashes sorted exact included session revision IDs/basis, accepted meter IDs+SHA, exclusion reasons and window/cutoff; `basis_sha256` additionally includes tariff revision/value/currency, source class/gate, formula `ev-gross-tariff/1`, state/reason and recorded basis. A changed selected cutoff or source/price revision appends history; identical basis is idempotent. `overlap_group='ev:'+sha256(canonical(tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,tariff_revision_id_or_NO_TARIFF))`; do not count a meter interval twice through two Findings. Session link quantity is exact included kWh; evidence link is each included accepted meter ID once. Keep exact Finding link nullable because Site consequence is not owned by one Finding.

Scope trigger selection by tenant/Site and overlapping selected window; use `ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,dirty_basis_sha256) DO NOTHING` only inside trigger and test a real INSERT path. A duplicate accepted upload or identical tariff request creates no duplicate consequence. `PostgresConsequenceStore` selects work without a SUCCEEDED attempt, locks by work ID transaction advisory lock, appends next `revision_no` for the Site/window and exact links plus a SUCCEEDED attempt atomically; a failed derivation appends FAILED with code and remains retryable. No no-op fictional zero consequence is required if no qualifying session exists: an empty-ID SUCCEEDED attempt is allowed and the read says no scenario assessed. +## Identity, selection and storage contract
+
+`ev_session` identity is scoped `(tenant_id,site_id,charger_asset_id,connector_asset_id,external_session_id)`, anchored to the first accepted START evidence ID and source time. An orphan terminal is retained as context in the selected read, not materialized as a started session. An accepted second START with distinct ID is a W2-00 `SESSION_ID_CONFLICT`; separately accepted ENDs/ABORTs remain analytic contradictory inputs. Effective `ev-roles-1` binding resolves the connector's *single* parent charger, exact source/device/signal and Foundation at each source time. Multiple/unknown parent, wrong connector or cross-Site ID is excluded with reason, never joined by label. No session starts from PLUGGED, status or a private vehicle request.
+
+Add 0025 tables/constraints exactly as EV design §1: scoped FKs and uniqueness, positive revision, ordered nullable bounds, nonnegative finite decimal kWh/error/unknown seconds, SUPPORT interval exclusion, immutable triggers and guarded downgrade. Reuse `analytic_run`, `analytic_run_evidence`, `assessment_revision`, `finding`, `finding_revision` and `recompute_job`; widen both Finding domain checks without loosening mini-grid/cold branches or nullable dispatch fields. For EV, `analytic_id='ev-session/1'`, `cohort_status='NOT_APPLICABLE'`, `cohort=[]`, `cohort_sha256=sha256(canonical([]))`. `finding.domain` and job domain are literal `ev_charging`. One fault-abort Finding key is SHA-256 of canonical tenant/Site/`EV_INTERRUPTION`/charger/connector/session/first START evidence. Finding subject is connector; START/FAULT/ABORT exact accepted IDs support the revision, its bounds are START→ABORT, dispatch minute columns null and limitation says fault observed while component cause and unmet demand remain unknown. A new basis appends a revision; a later contradiction withdraws current support without deleting the old record.
+
+For a strict selected half-open UTC `[from,to)` of at most 31 days and committed `known_at`, select accepted GOOD, clock-attested, time-valid records at that cutoff. One START, at most one nonconflicting terminal and source order within the declared 30 s cross-source error establish state. Missing terminal stays INCOMPLETE even if status turns idle. ABORT without a same-session contemporaneous fault is OBSERVED_ABORT but creates no fault-associated Finding. SUSPECT, unattested, wrong binding and ambiguous records are CONTEXT/EXCLUDED with exact reason and IDs. Basis SHA hashes sorted accepted ID+content SHA/use/reason, Foundation/binding/mapping revisions, model/rule version, exact window/cutoff and source class. Replaying the same basis is idempotent; a later END, terminal conflict, meter or source-gate change appends an immutable revision.
+
+For each started session, intersect meter `INTERVAL_DELTA` reports with `[START,terminal)` (or selected read boundary while incomplete), requiring same connector and session, GOOD clock/source and wholly contained nonoverlapping half-open interval. Reject a spanning unsplit report, overlap, negative/nonfinite delta, or `kWh > connector_max_kW × hours + 2×meter_error_bound`. Sum accepted exact Decimal deltas. Unknown seconds are the union of uncovered active five-minute slots clipped to bounds. `supported_kwh=null` with zero supported intervals; otherwise it is explicitly partial until all active slots, including split boundary slots, are covered and terminal is sound. `energy_complete=false` for incomplete/contradictory or any gap. No selected report implies zero energy; no power-integrated substitute. Status one-minute slots can give known/unknown service context but no W2 availability percentage or equipment-health conclusion. Site import below configured limit is context only, never proof that site power did or did not cause a stop.
+
+Use a caller-supplied transaction in `assessment_worker.py` + `postgres_assessment_store.py` to append analytic run, assessment, session/revision/evidence/intervals, optional Finding and links, then complete the job; rollback all on any invariant failure. Enqueue `ev_charging` on every newly accepted relevant v4 EV event, state, meter or binding/source-gate change, including late source time. Dirty the affected session/window heads with scoped joins; a failed/leased/pending overlapping job keeps current reads `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`, never silently current. Preserve exact old revision at explicit historical cutoff. A duplicate batch adds no new assessment. Do not use the stale older head for a new current claim.

+## 0026 schema, writer and exact money calculation
+
+Migration 0026 widens only the existing `financial_assumption_revision` key/unit checks for `ev_gross_tariff_per_kwh`. Preserve diesel `currency/L`, authored/source/valid/recorded succession, correction and overlap checks, existing API authorization/idempotency and mini-grid fuel consequence check. Existing fuel consequence rows/checks stay byte-identical. Downgrade refuses while EV tariff revisions or consequences/work/history exist; no cascade deletion.

+One canonical Site/window consequence lineage, not a per-Finding sum: aggregate distinct included `ev_meter_interval` accepted evidence IDs across latest settled selected session revisions. For every included interval, session outcome must be COMPLETED or OBSERVED_ABORT, `energy_complete=true` across that session's active span, and no contradictory/unattested/overlap condition. An aborted session contributes only delivered pre-abort intervals; its unmet demand is unknown. Exclude incomplete sessions as *whole-session pricing* while displaying their supported partial kWh separately. At selected cutoff, each interval must be covered by exactly one tariff revision's valid range and recorded visibility; v1 requires the **same revision and currency for all included intervals**. A valid selected empty window has no eligible quantity, so `quantity_kwh=null` and no ESTIMATED zero. A tariff gap, two revisions across a window, missing tariff or unsupported unit yields `UNPRICED/PRICE_GAP_OR_CHANGE` (or `TARIFF_MISSING` for no revision) and null amount. A pending/failed/late assessment, contradictory meter, historical cutoff offered as current, source class MIXED/UNKNOWN or incoherent price/source basis yields `WITHHELD` and null current amount. A historical exact revision may display its old amount with a clear **Historical scenario** label, never as the current amount. No counterfactual sales, billing collections, margin, repair or warranty amount is computed.

+`technical_input_sha256` hashes sorted exact included session revision IDs/basis, accepted meter IDs+SHA, exclusion reasons and window/cutoff; `basis_sha256` additionally includes tariff revision/value/currency, source class/gate, formula `ev-gross-tariff/1`, state/reason and recorded basis. Session link quantity is exact included kWh; evidence link is each included accepted meter ID once. Keep exact Finding link nullable because Site consequence is not owned by one Finding.

A duplicate accepted upload or identical tariff request creates no duplicate consequence. `PostgresConsequenceStore` selects work without a SUCCEEDED attempt, locks by work ID transaction advisory lock, appends next `revision_no` for the Site/window and exact links plus a SUCCEEDED attempt atomically; a failed derivation appends FAILED with code and remains retryable. No no-op fictional zero consequence is required if no qualifying session exists: an empty-ID SUCCEEDED attempt is allowed and the read says no scenario assessed. ## Architect dry-read resolution (2026-10-18; governs any earlier ambiguous wording)

**QA-QD amendment (2026-10-18; governs the W2-05a commit-1 handoff).**

- **QA, timezone:** Use `Etc/UTC` as the EV-LAB-001 Site timezone and as both schedule `time_zone` values, with `utc_offset_minutes=0`. It is an IANA Area/Location name accepted by the shared Site parser. Do not widen that parser for bare `UTC`; replace the earlier fixture wording `UTC` wherever it denotes a Site or schedule zone. UTC timestamps and offset-zero semantics are unchanged.
- **QB, property kinds:** `ev-charger-max-power`, `ev-connector-max-power`, `ev-meter-resolution`, `ev-meter-error-bound` and `ev-clock-error-bound` are `PHYSICAL`. `ev-site-import-limit`, `ev-status-cadence` and `ev-meter-cadence` are `CONTROL`. `ev-connector-enabled` remains `CONTROL`. These are definition kinds, independent of whether a value is currently observed.
- **QC, absent feed:** A Site with no `AC_BUS` may publish a declared charger, meter and connector as an incomplete configuration, provided all declared charger/connector properties and schedule entries are valid. More than one parent for a meter, charger or connector always refuses publication. Once a feed is declared, every declared meter must have exactly that feed as its parent and every declared charger must have exactly one path through a meter from that feed; an unfed meter or charger refuses `EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID`. Any nonempty connector service schedule requires a complete feedâ†’meterâ†’chargerâ†’connector path, even when the Site has no feed.
- **QD, feed cardinality:** Refuse a second `AC_BUS` in an EV Foundation with `EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID` and a path to the extra feed. The selected response has one `feed`, and no arbitrary feed selection or merged limit is valid. Zero or one feed is publishable subject to the rules above; Draft still requires the feed and its limit.

Build in reviewable commits: **1 vocabulary, parser, typed schedule and validator; 2 EV roles, closed v4 channel matrix, binding publication/snapshot and fixture; 3 selected API; 4 three UI routes and visual proof; 5 migration and final guards/tests.** Commit 5 may be prepared only after W2-04 `0023` is merged into this branch. No interim EV migration is permitted; `0024_w2_ev_config` is reserved for 05a. Run each commit's focused checks and hand off before the next builder run.

**Q1, connector identity.** `BINDING_CHANNEL_OVERLAP` and `EV_CONNECTOR_MISMATCH` stay unchanged. In EV-LAB-001 the c1 tuples are `(c1-charger-controller,session-event)`, `(c1-connector-controller,fault-event|state|requested-power|allocated-limit)`, `(c1-connector-meter,energy|power)`; c2 uses the identical signal names with `c2-` device prefixes. Each of these three devices and seven channels per connector has `component_id=c1` or `c2` respectively and binds to that same EV_CONNECTOR asset. `(site-meter,import)` has `component_id=site-meter-1`, binds to its METER asset, and is the sole Site import channel. `charger-1` is topology and ratings only; it owns no connector channel. Each tuple is a distinct exact entry in `V4_CHANNEL_MAPPINGS`; no prefix wildcard or runtime-generated accepted tuple. Keep the two old unsuffixed W2-00 reserved tuples for their existing tests, label their roles, but do not bind them in this fixture. The v4 snapshot metadata must come from the exact entry. S2's existing one-binding connector check continues to compare the envelope connector asset ID to c1 or c2.

**Q2, readiness.** `CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE` applies to `CONNECTOR_NOT_DECLARED`, `FEED_OR_LIMIT_MISSING`, `METER_NOT_BOUND`, `SESSION_EVENTS_NOT_BOUND`, or `STATUS_NOT_BOUND`; `SITE_IMPORT_NOT_BOUND` is a nonblocking capability message under `READY_TO_REPORT`, as are `SOURCE_NOT_CONTACTED` and `COMMISSIONING_UNCONFIRMED`. Missing optional fault, connector power, requested power or allocated limit yields no readiness code; the exact capability that needs it stays unavailable. Required energy, event and state bindings are per declared connector. A configured Site may be ready while source contact and commissioning remain unknown.

**Q3, absent properties.** Missing `ev-site-import-limit` on an otherwise valid feed is the sole publishable numeric gap and emits `FEED_OR_LIMIT_MISSING`; absence of feed or all connectors is likewise publishable as configuration-incomplete so the selected read can explain it. For every *declared* charger/connector, missing `ev-charger-max-power`, `ev-connector-max-power`, `ev-connector-enabled`, `ev-meter-resolution`, `ev-meter-error-bound`, `ev-status-cadence`, `ev-meter-cadence` or `ev-clock-error-bound` refuses Foundation publication with `EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID` and a path to that property. Present wrong type/unit, nonfinite/out-of-range value, invalid topology or schedule uses the same typed refusal. Do not pretend a missing physical or clock parameter is a readiness finding. A Site with no declared connector cannot publish a binding set or Draft a Lab run.

**Q4, cadence.** `ev-status-cadence` on each connector converts min to seconds and must be `0 < value <= 1`; it is the published state-channel cadence. `ev-meter-cadence` converts min to seconds and must be `0 < value <= 5`; it governs connector energy, connector power, Site import, requested power and allocated limit, all of which publish aligned 300-second *maximum* slots for this profile; the fixture declares exactly 5 min. Event channels have null cadence. `BindingRequest` has no cadence field: derive `bindings[].cadence_seconds` only from the selected Foundation property. Reject a property above its ceiling at Foundation publication (`EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID`); reject any future submitted cadence field as `BINDING_REQUEST_INVALID`, not an invented `BINDING_CADENCE_INVALID`. `ev-clock-error-bound` is positive seconds and is recorded as the selected configured tolerance; 05a makes no observed clock-attestation claim. No cadence is inferred from observed timestamps.

**Q5, schedule.** Add `connector_enable_schedules` to `foundation_parsing.py:FOUNDATION_CONTENT_KEYS` and both parser allowlists through that shared constant; it is not `site_controls`. Exactly one schedule entry per declared connector, including a disabled connector (which has an empty `weekly` array); an enabled connector may have an empty weekly array, meaning no service hours. Each entry's zone equals the Site's IANA `timezone`. The fixture zone is `Etc/UTC`, weekly TUESDAY 08:00â€“16:00 with offset 0 for both c1/c2, so it recurs on Tuesdays during the revision's effective period, not just 6 October. For a bounded effective interval, enumerate each occurrence and validate offset and real, unambiguous local endpoints throughout that interval. For an open-ended interval, permit only zones whose offset is fixed for all future occurrences (`Etc/UTC` qualifies); a DST zone needs a bounded revision and a successor when its offset changes. Reject overlap, invalid endpoint and missing entry as `EV_CONFIGURATION_INVALID`. At selected `at`, the effective revision supplies its own schedule; never merge schedules across revisions.

**Q6, fixtures.** 05a creates `backend/tests/fixtures/w2/ev-lab-001.yaml` and registers the Site in its focused test/setup path. There is one Site, `EV-LAB-001`: the stocked Foundation and published binding revision are its first complete basis. Missing meter/event/status examples are separate *test-created binding revisions* on that same Site, with nonoverlapping effective periods after the 6 October complete-run window; the missing-limit example is a later Foundation revision on the same Site. Tests use isolated stores/DBs and pin `at` and revision IDs, so 05b's complete 6 October basis is untouched. No new Site codes are introduced. A revision never rewrites the original. 05b adds scenarios and uses this fixture, not a second copy.

**Q7, migration order.** W2-04 owns `0023`; 05a reserves `0024_w2_ev_config` now. Vocabulary/API/UI commits may proceed before 0023, but do not generate or test 0024 against 0022. Merge reviewed 0023 into the 05a branch, create `0024` with `down_revision` pointing to 0023, then run upgrade/downgrade and final tests. 05b adds no migration.

**Q8, kinds and profile.** `ev_connector_energy` has role `value_kind=INTERVAL_DELTA`, source/canonical unit kWh, parameter-free `IDENTITY_KWH` that accepts only kWh. Other EV interval roles use `value_kind=NUMBER`, `IDENTITY`, kW and v4 `INTERVAL_MEAN`; STATE uses `ENUM`, and EVENT uses `IDENTITY`. `(cX-connector-meter,energy)` requires nonnull session and connector in v4; power and controller interval channels require connector and carry session when a session exists; Site import has explicit-null session/connector. Preserve existing `V4_MAPPING_PROFILE_ID=simulator-lab-gateway-cold` for cold and its historical snapshots; EV binds under the new exact `simulator-lab-gateway-ev/1` profile, with an explicit profile-to-closed-table lookup. Do not mutate cold profile/version or v3 bytes. 05b registers the producer for that EV profile.

Exclude incomplete sessions as *whole-session pricing* while displaying their supported partial kWh separately. +## Identity, selection and storage contract
+
+`ev_session` identity is scoped `(tenant_id,site_id,charger_asset_id,connector_asset_id,external_session_id)`, anchored to the first accepted START evidence ID and source time. An orphan terminal is retained as context in the selected read, not materialized as a started session.
